tags: - Single canvas character grid covering the whole sheet, drawn by blitting cells from an offscreen glyph atlas with eight ink variants (overstrike bold, faint, two ribbon colours, inverse) - Height field of five summed travelling waves with crest sharpening, wind skew, deep-water dispersion and per-row perspective; glyphs chosen from slope, height, depth and a decaying foam buffer - Screen-space displacement lookup so tall near water occludes what is behind it - Procedural sky: value-noise cloud wisps, hashed twinkling stars, lane-based slanted rain, clock-positioned sun and moon - Sprite sets in ASCII for boat (pitched and mirrored), lighthouse, buoy, gulls and whale, with dithered mirror reflections in calm water - Beach swash simulation with foam fringe, wet line memory that dries, and a stacked tide line of typed words that crumbles with age - Paper drawn in code: green bars with hairlines, sprocket holes, micro-perforations, pre-printed line numbers, margin form legend, grain and fibres - Ribbon wear mask composited with destination-out, and occasional sub-pixel row misalignment - Entrance choreography: stepped paper feed, print-head sweep per line, in-place reprinting of changed footer text - Full-sheet colour inversion for lightning with a glyph bolt and typed "!" thunder - Web Audio surf, hiss, dot-matrix buzz, bell, plop and thunder synthesised from noise and oscillators (off by default)

notes.zh: 作者自述：A quiet nocturnal instrument: one cratered Moon hanging in a sparse field of fixed stars on night black, shown at the phase it has at this very minute. Beneath it the phase name is set in very large, light serif type, followed by one italic line of copy written for that phase and a single ruled row of tabular data (illumination, age, date and time). A small column lists the next four principal phases, with the coming full moon in harvest gold; along the bottom edge a tape of day-by-day moon glyphs slides under a fixed index, today ringed in gold. Dragging the tape sweeps the terminator across real relief: crater rims catch the light, floors fill with shadow, the old Moon in earthshine appears around new, and every readout ticks along. The page opens in darkness, the lit limb arrives as a hairline, the light sweeps to the true phase and the title letters settle into place.

tags: - Per-pixel sphere rendering on Canvas 2D from buffers baked once: height field, perturbed normals, albedo, edge coverage - Procedural surface from a fixed seed: about 2,500 craters with a power-law size distribution (bowl, raised rim, flat floors and central peaks on the largest, older craters softened), young craters with noise-broken ray systems - Maria as a merged field of soft blobs eroded by four octaves of lattice noise, with fewer craters inside them - Lunar (Lommel-Seeliger style) photometry so the full disc is evenly bright to the limb while the terminator stays sharp - True cast shadows from a row-wise horizon sweep, exact because the Sun always lies in the plane of each pixel row - Earthshine: a dim blue-grey rendering of the night side that swells toward new moon - Faint scattered-light bloom built from two down-sampled copies of the frame, no blur filters - Seeded star field occulted by the opaque dark limb - Canvas tape of two-arc phase glyphs with a lens swell at the index, edge fade and dated principal phases - Phase astronomy from the mean synodic month counted from the 6 January 2000 new moon; next phases, age and illuminated fraction computed live - Light didone-style serif at display size against 11px tracked small-caps data with tabular numerals; four-colour palette with gold reserved for today and the next full moon - Entrance choreography with custom easing: hairline limb, sweeping light, staggered letter settle; live phase glyph drawn into the tab icon

notes.zh: 作者自述：A full-bleed painted landscape in gold and slate: two-thirds of the screen is a field of ripe wheat receding to a hazy horizon of hills, hedgerow trees, a spire and a lone oak, under stacked flat-shaded storm clouds with a cream sun-break and light shafts. After one still beat a gust enters from the left and the whole field comes alive: every stalk is its own spring, leaning and overshooting as bands of wind sweep through in perspective, turning the crop silver-pale where it bends and dark just ahead, so the wind itself becomes visible as waves rolling away. In the foreground, individual ears with paired grains and trembling awns nod above olive grass, a few poppies and cornflowers; swallows scatter from a telegraph wire when a gust reaches them and a kite circles. Over four minutes a dark bank slides in, the light narrows, the caption counts down, heavy drops streak and spot the wheat, thunder mutters, and the weather eases back into bright wind to begin again. The experience is meant to feel like standing at a field margin, expectant and tender, with the option of putting a hand out into the wheat.

tags: - Canvas 2D scene of roughly 8,000 stalks in typed arrays, sorted back to front and drawn in depth bands, batched per colour bucket - Per-stalk damped spring driven by a wind vector field (travelling gust fronts, turbulence, pointer puffs, squall arcs) evaluated on a low-resolution grid with non-uniform rows and bilinear sampling - Tone field coupling wind strength to colour (sheen behind a front, dark shoulder ahead), plus drifting cloud shadows and a travelling sun patch, used both for stalk colour and for a smoothed ground image - Three levels of detail: single strokes far away, stem plus spindle ear in the middle distance, fully drawn ears with paired grains, leaves and lagging awns in the foreground - Pseudo-perspective depth mapping so fronts and squalls narrow, slow and thin toward the vanishing point; squall speed and width scale with depth so the wave stays legible to the horizon - Procedural cloud sprites: stacked lobe layers with clipped offset fills for three flat slate tones, and a separate sun-rim layer masked by a radial gradient around the moving sun-break - Pre-rendered horizon (hills, far fields, tree line, church), oak and rain-curtain sprites; telegraph poles and oak interleaved with the wheat rows for correct occlusion - Weather cycle driving sky gradient, storm bank, ambient colour ramps, rain streaks, wet spots, sheet lightning and the caption countdown - Animated birds: perching and flocking swallows, a banking kite, a skylark with rise, hover, parachute and plunge phases and drawn song marks - Field-margin layer of sprung grass blades, poppies and cornflowers; chaff and seed-head particles in strong gusts - Static grain canvas blended in soft light and a gentle vignette; SVG wheat-ear sound toggle with spring easing - Web Audio synthesis: filtered noise for wind, rustle, rain, squall whoosh and thunder, and a scheduled sine trill for the lark

notes.zh: 作者自述：A history-of-science vitrine with the glass taken away. A large engraved brass astrolabe lies on a lamplit parchment table beside a column of museum text headed by the cinnabar exhibit number IV.12 and the invitation "Please touch." The instrument is lowered onto the table, its shackle swings, and the rete makes one slow turn before stopping at the present hour with the rule laid through the Sun's bead, so that at rest it is already telling the time. Every circle on it is real stereographic geometry for the chosen latitude, and a label-card panel reads the instrument back in plain language as the visitor turns it: the Sun's place in the zodiac, its height, the hour under the rule, the degree rising and the degree culminating. Three numbered tasks teach sunrise, day length and culmination step by step, ticking themselves off as the visitor succeeds. On request the whole instrument separates into a calm axonometric stack of pin, horse, rule, rete, plate and mater, each named and explained, and then settles back together.

title.zh: Par Avion — The Journey of One Letter
title.en: Par Avion — The Journey of One Letter

notes.zh: 作者自述：A single airmail envelope sits at the centre of a kraft-paper stage and never leaves it. As the viewer scrolls, nine flat, duotone postal scenes conveyor past behind it — a rain-streaked pillar box, a cancelling machine, the pigeonholes of a night mail train, an aerodrome, a desert stopover, a flying boat, a colonial G.P.O. counter, a mail boat and a cliff-road bicycle, a schoolhouse — while a top ribbon traces the route on an invented map and a ticker runs the local date and time. The envelope is the travelogue: each stage physically strikes, sticks, stains or creases it, with handstamps that drop in, thump and lift away leaving patchy, slightly doubled ink that dries from wet to matte. Captions on airmail-edged cards speak in the dry voice of a public-information film. At the end the envelope turns over, a paper-knife opens it, and the letter it has been carrying the whole way unfolds: a brother writing to his sister about rain, a ship's cat, an honest kettle and their mother's knee. Scrolling back up un-stamps every mark and sends the letter home.

notes.zh: 作者自述：A bright, clinical lab-manual page built around a living ripple tank. A framed tray of pale aqua water sits on a white bench with corner screws, legs and an apparatus shelf beneath it; numbered experiment tabs run across the top like headings in a practical handbook, and a side column carries the experiment note, one live formula, the frequency control and the probe plot. The page opens on the double slit: a plane wave marches from a red bar, strikes a lab-blue wall, and two fans of wavelets cross into alternating beams of glittering crests and calm nodal lanes, while red hand-drawn arrows name the central maximum and a nodal line and the plot beside the tank grows a row of fringes under thin red prediction ticks. Everything in the tank can be dragged, rotated, resized or thrown out, so each textbook diagram can be bent into another one.

tags: - Real-time 2D wave equation in WebGL: ping-pong float textures, two-step update with a nine-point isotropic Laplacian, per-cell wave speed, barrier mask and an absorbing sponge at the edges - Shadowgraph shading: brightness from surface curvature, so crests focus into near-white caustic lines and troughs fall to cyan and deep blue, with a time-averaged activity tint that leaves nodal lines pale and calm - Bench grid seen through the water, its lookup offset by the height gradient so the lines wobble with the waves - Barriers, mirrors and glass plates painted into a mask canvas and uploaded as a texture; drawn in the shader with soft cast shadows, highlight edges and glass rims - Stroboscope mode using a third texture as a phase-locked snapshot, with no copy pass - SVG overlay in centimetre units for dippers, wave bar, slit marks, rotation handles, ruler and probe, all sized to stay constant on screen - Hand-drawn red annotation arrows that draw themselves with stroke-dash animation and fade after ten seconds - Live SVG intensity plot with predicted maxima computed from path difference, plus peak-spacing and wavelength read-outs measured from a CPU companion simulation - Canvas 2D ImageData fallback engine with the same physics and interactions - Lab-manual typography: tracked small-caps title, oversized outlined experiment numeral, monospace read-outs with italic serif variables, flat outlined buttons that invert when pressed

notes.zh: 作者自述：A tiny diorama of a roadside railcar diner at three in the morning, drawn entirely with HTML boxes and CSS 3D transforms and floating on a disc of asphalt that fades into the dark. Nothing is lit when the page opens except the windows and one streetlamp; then the billboard strikes, tube by tube, the M failing twice, and pink and cyan light spills over the roof, the lot and the puddles, which reflect the words themselves upside down. Inside, a cook flips, a waitress walks the counter and stops to pour, one customer stirs and another turns a page. Around it: a parked sedan, an idling pickup, a phone box, moths at the lamp, a freight train on the horizon and, now and then, a car going somewhere else. A paperback-noir title and three lines of prose frame it, with a small bakelite panel of switches and jukebox keys.

tags: - One isometric rig (rotateX 55deg, rotateZ 45deg, preserve-3d); every object is a single element extruded into a box with its two pseudo-elements as side faces, sized by custom properties - Neon lettering as outlined text with layered text-shadow glow over a dim unlit copy; per-letter stepped keyframes with uneven opacity steps and staggered delays for the strike, plus one letter that flickers forever - Inline SVG comet outline with three tail tubes lit in a chasing sequence; dot-matrix "bulb" lettering made with a radial-gradient clipped to text - Glow washes (blurred radial gradients on the ground, roof and sky) driven by keyframes matched to the letter timings - Puddles whose reflections are generated text, flipped, blurred and wavering with animated skew - Stainless-steel ribbing, checkerboard floor, parking bays, road markings and window mullions all from repeating gradients - Billboarded planes (counter-rotated to face the viewer) for steam puffs, musical quavers, the pie dome, lamp halo and phone rings - Shadow-play silhouettes on the window blinds synchronised with the 3D waitress - Slanted rain built from tiled elliptical gradients moved on the compositor; film grain from an inline SVG turbulence filter - Checkbox, radio, :checked, :hover and :focus-visible selectors for all state; custom properties carry the jukebox colour and tempo

title.zh: A Short History of Fog in Port Verrow
title.en: A Short History of Fog in Port Verrow

notes.zh: 作者自述：A magazine long-read from the invented quarterly "The Lee Shore" whose weather is its subject. The page opens almost blank: an amber harbour lamp glows at the end of a silhouetted mole, the letters of the huge wide-tracked title condense out of the mist one by one, and then a slow, volumetric fog settles into its drift between the reader and the essay. Text is always dark slate ink underneath; the fog is thick in the top and bottom of the window and thin in a reading band across the middle, so paragraphs come into legibility as they are scrolled to the centre and thin away again. Each of the five sections has its own weather: a light sea-fret for the vocabulary, a dense smoor for the foghorn, a near-total blanket for 1952, and a clear, sharp morning for the close. A fixed "Visibility" readout names the current conditions, the foghorn sends an amber ring through the fog every ninety seconds of story-time, and a "Lift the fog" control clears everything for anyone who simply wants to read.

tags: - Full-viewport WebGL fragment shader above the content: three layers of domain-warped fbm value noise drifting at different speeds, premultiplied alpha, rendered at reduced resolution with dither grain - Vertical density profile with a noise-broken "reading band"; density and band width interpolate per section from data attributes - Clearing mask from an array of eighteen pointer/puff/focus points passed as uniforms, with noise-wobbled edges and a four-second decay - Amber lantern tint around the pointer and an exponential amber halo around the harbour lamp, both drawn in the fog itself - Foghorn ripple: an expanding ring that displaces the noise domain, thins the fog and reveals a DOM amber sound-ring beneath it - Scroll-coupled fog: partial parallax of the noise field and velocity-driven shear and stirring - Letter-by-letter blur-to-focus title entrance timed against a flat fog veil that thins over the first three seconds - Book typography: 34em serif column, real indents, three-line amber drop caps, small-caps first lines and cross-heads, hanging quotation marks, marginal notes that fall inline on phones - Very large italic pull quotes with a gradient mask so their lower halves sink into the fog - Hand-drawn inline SVG: chart fragment with soundings and depth contours, foghorn house in elevation with animated sound arcs, rooftops-and-masts skyline with parallax and density-linked opacity - Tide-and-fog calendar for October 1952 built as a CSS grid: cells shaded by hours of fog, amber bars for tidal range, the Blanket outlined - Fallback without WebGL: two drifting SVG-turbulence textures with a radial mask that follows the pointer and a CSS lantern glow - Web Audio foghorn: two detuned sawtooth oscillators plus a sub sine per note, low-pass filtered, slow attack and long release, over a filtered-noise sea wash with slow LFOs - Paper grain from an SVG noise texture; palette restricted to #E6E8E6, #BFC5C4, #26302F and #D98E04

notes.zh: 作者自述：A sunny one-button arcade game set at the counter of the invented Gelateria Belmonte. A waffle cone stands in a mint holder on a marble counter beneath a blue-and-cream striped awning whose valance is lettered "Torre di Gelato"; between two pastel seaside houses lies a sliver of sea with a sailboat, a promenade railing and a gull. A server's striped sleeve swings a spade overhead, and each tap drops a soft scoop that squashes, ruffles, sticks and makes the whole tower lean, sway and overcorrect, every scoop jiggling a beat behind the one below. Dawdle and the sun melts the lower scoops into drips that run down the cone and pool on the marble. As the tower climbs, the camera leaves the awning behind and rises past washing lines, rooftop cats and aerials, a bell tower whose clock shows the viewer's own time, gulls, a kite, a hot-air balloon, thin clouds, a banner plane, a crescent moon, stars and a small satellite, each with a dashed height marker. Three dropped scoops end the round with a slow, messy cascade onto the counter and a paper receipt listing every flavour in order, with a total and a dry verdict from Signora Belmonte.

tags: - Canvas 2D scene drawn entirely procedurally, with a world camera that pans vertically and sways gently with the tower's lean - Tower physics as a chain of angular-spring joints: gravity torque from the centre of mass above each joint, sticky spring-back, light damping and inertial lag so upper scoops wobble out of phase - Per-scoop spring-driven squash factor (about 80% on impact, bulging sideways), shear jiggle, and a compression wave passed down the stack on every landing - Scoops rendered with a scalloped ruffled skirt, radial soft shading, highlight, contact shadow and per-flavour flecks (chips, nut pieces, shards, zest, seeds, cherry swirl, ice crystals) - Melting: skirt scallops lengthen into drips, teardrops grow, detach, follow the tower and cone silhouette and pool on the counter, faster when the sun is out from behind its cloud - Splat shapes with spreading puddles, flying droplets and a counter shake; sprinkle bursts and a hand-lettered "perfetto!" on centred drops - Procedural waffle crosshatch on the cone and wafer discs; swaying awning scallops; title lettering that writes itself across the valance on load - Layered altitude backdrop with a sky gradient that shifts from cream to blue to night, twinkling stars and animated set pieces at set heights - DOM interface pieces styled as objects: a hanging chocolate price-board, a punched flavour ticket, plastic spoons as lives, a zigzag-edged receipt; spring easing throughout - Paper grain overlay and a warm sunlight wash; synthesised plop, bell and splat sounds, off by default

title.zh: Strange Attractors — A Collection of Orbits
title.en: Strange Attractors — A Collection of Orbits

notes.zh: 作者自述：A dark viridian vitrine holds one strange attractor at a time, built from up to 480,000 points of gold dust whose overlapping density, not any drawn line, makes the form: thin outer loops are faint threads, the folded cores glow champagne, and a jade shadow of the same density lies on a graduated floor ring beneath. The page is composed like a museum label on glass: a large Didone name and plate number at top left, the governing equations set in italic serif with live, draggable constants at bottom left, a row of seven miniature specimens at bottom right. The experience is slow and tactile: the specimen turns on its own until taken in hand, a swarm of bright tracers shows which way the flow runs and how quickly neighbours part, and every change of plate or constant makes the whole cloud dissolve and re-settle into its new shape rather than cut.

tags: - WebGL point cloud of 220,000–480,000 RK4-integrated samples, additively accumulated in a half-float framebuffer and tone-mapped through a gold-to-champagne ramp - Vertex-shader morphing between two position buffers with per-point staggered easing, drift and sag, so shapes melt and re-condense - Per-point speed attribute steering warmth, depth fog toward jade, perspective-attenuated point size with sub-pixel energy compensation - Flattened jade shadow pass of the same buffer on the vitrine floor, with thin tick-marked axes, a graduated ring and projected axis letters - Real-time tracer particles with fading trails integrated live from the same equations, seeded as a tight cluster - Time-ordered draw-range sweep for the entrance, with a counting point total - Sub-step jitter along each trajectory segment to remove sampling beads and give a dust grain - Butterfly-effect instrument: SVG log plot of separation with live least-squares Lyapunov estimate - Equations typeset in HTML with italic variables, aligned equals signs, stacked fractions, superscripts and dotted derivatives; parameters highlighted in gold - Procedurally drawn thumbnail index, hairline frame with corner ticks, SVG grain and vignette over the canvas - Canvas 2D density-accumulation fallback with the same palette when WebGL is unavailable - Staggered Didone letter entrances and custom cubic-bezier easing throughout

notes.zh: 作者自述：A sunny mid-century instructional poster that is also a working instrument. A flat, geometric sailor stands on a signal deck with a rail, a lifebuoy, a coil of rope, the sea horizon, a steamer and one small cloud, holding two diagonally divided red-and-yellow flags. Type a message onto an invented naval message form (S.1320, with TO / FROM / TIME boxes and ruled typewriter lines), press SEND, and the signaller spells it out in correct flag semaphore: arms snapping the shortest way round an eight-point clock with a slight wind-up and overshoot, flags folding edge-on through the move and cracking open with follow-through, the body leaning and bobbing with each position, rests between words, a quick drop between double letters, and the numerals and letters-follow signs inserted automatically. A strip of tiny static glyphs lights up in red in step with the performance while the current character stands beside the figure in huge stencil type. On load the signaller calls attention with both flags and spells HELLO unasked. A second tab turns the page into a reading trainer with a streak counter and a ship's bell, and a reference chart of thirty positions, grouped by the seven circles of the code, lets the viewer play the signaller like an instrument by hovering, tapping or pressing letter keys. Everything is shown as seen by the observer, and says so.

tags: - Inline SVG scene in four flat colours (sailcloth, flag red, flag yellow, navy) with CSS-animated sun rays, drifting cloud, swell and a distant steamer - Arms as rotating SVG groups driven by a custom cubic-bezier solver (anticipation and overshoot), shortest-path angle interpolation with an own-side rule for half turns - Flag cloth rebuilt every frame as two curved triangles: quadratic and cubic paths fitted through a deformation function, with a damped spring that folds the flag edge-on against the motion and a travelling wave for wind ripple - Secondary springs for body lean, knee bob, head counter-tilt and fluttering cap ribbons - Semaphore table encoded once as arm-position pairs on an eight-point compass and reused for the big figure, title glyphs, message strip, trainer comparison and chart - Stencil lettering made from condensed system faces with a CSS mask bridge cut (and an SVG bridge on the big letter) - Canvas weave from layered repeating gradients, double-rule poster border with rope-twist corner knots drawn in SVG - Signal-flag chips cut with clip-path (swallowtail and pennant shapes), a rotary speed dial, perforated message-pad paper with ruled lines - Web Audio synthesis, off by default: filtered-noise flag snaps, breathing sea ambience and an additive ship's bell - Sticky signal deck so the figure stays in view beside the pad, trainer and chart; reduced-motion mode with direct arm moves and static flags

notes.zh: 作者自述：A sunlit, nearly monochrome amber landing page for a nine-hive honey producer, built from one material and one shape. A turned beech dipper lowers into the top of the page and lets go of a single thread of honey that falls through the oversized serif headline and coils like a rope onto the first cell of a full-bleed honeycomb. Scrolling makes the comb fill outward from that landing point: each cell rises with a curved meniscus, then most are sealed with a dimpled wax cap while some stay open and glossy. Three seven-cell clearings in the comb hold the three honeys with their hexagonal jars. Bees patrol the cell walls, fly off in arcs and drift toward a resting cursor. Below the comb everything remains hexagonal: a twelve-cell ring calendar, interlocking number cells, a compass and a dance floor for the waggle dance, and an order cell that ends in a pressed wax seal. The voice is first person plural, dry and fond of its bees.

tags: - Canvas 2D honey material: three-layer ribbons (deep edge, amber body, cream specular line) with per-point width, and radial-gradient blobs with a dark core and a thick highlight crescent - Liquid rope-coil: the thread's landing point circles while older loops sink, widen and taper into a growing mound; a slow bead of thickness travels down the thread - Pointy-top hexagonal grid computed in script, re-tiled at 3, 5, 7, 9 or 11 columns, with merged seven-cell regions outlined by their perimeter edges only - Cached base layer and pre-rendered sprites for capped and open cells; only the visible band of the comb is redrawn each frame - Cell fill animation with a clipped quadratic meniscus, sloshing surface and cross-faded wax cap; fill order is distance from the thread's landing point, driven by scroll - Honey runner that wells up, slides down the vertical walls with eased acceleration, leaves a thinning trail and pools in cells two rows below - Procedurally drawn bees walking the vertex lattice of the comb, with Bezier flight arcs, ground shadows and ghosted wing ovals for blur - Inline SVG dipper with cylindrical beech gradients and an animated grain pattern to suggest turning; SVG hexagonal jars whose honey surface levels out far more slowly than the jar tilts - Hand-drawn stencil lettering for the No. 9 hive lockup; twelve line icons for the months; wax seal with a debossed bee - CSS clip-path hexagons for every content cell, honey-rise fills on selection, an SVG turbulence paper grain and a faint comb pattern across the whole page - Georgia display type at dramatic scale against tracked geometric-sans labels; tabular lining figures for numbers and prices

notes.zh: 作者自述：Lumen is a municipal power dashboard built as a model-railway board: an isometric pastel town of some thirty buildings on a steel-blue plinth, with a wind ridge, a sun field, a weir, a battery barn and a pylon line to the mainland, all wired to a tiny substation. One simulation of a 24-hour day drives both the model and the instruments around it. The board opens empty, buildings spring up district by district, wires string themselves between poles, and yellow dashes begin to run along them at a speed and density that match the kilowatts on each line. As dusk falls the board tints from cream through pink to a dim lavender, windows light house by house, the Bijou's marquee comes on, the wind drops, and the viewer watches the battery barn's flow turn round and the interconnector start importing. Around the model sit a day dial, frequency gauge, segmented battery, a 24-hour stacked supply chart with the demand line, today's mix ring, a carbon-free streak, the mainland account in pounds and a dryly written event log, all in the same flat navy-outlined style.

tags: - Isometric SVG scene generated from a 24 by 24 grid with a 30 degree projection; every building built from three-tone flat faces (top lightest, left mid, right darkest) with thin navy outlines - Painter's-algorithm depth sorting, with the moving tram re-inserted into the sort order as it circles its loop - Ground plane drawn in grid units through a single isometric matrix, including district names lettered flat on the board and plaque text on the plinth faces - Power flow as layered dash strokes on each wire: one inherited stroke-dashoffset per wire, three phase-shifted dash layers whose opacity encodes load, navy keylines under yellow dashes, smooth reversal through zero - Day and night lighting by a full-board multiply overlay interpolated through cream, white, dusk pink and lavender, with lit windows, lamps, marquee and flow drawn above it so only the yellow glows - Springy staggered entrance (custom overshoot bezier) and wires that draw themselves by dash length - Deterministic value-noise weather, bell-curve sun, per-building load schedules, battery state of charge, import and export balancing, priority load shedding when islanded - Second-order spring frequency needle that dips on load steps, a segmented battery, a dash-array donut, and a stacked area chart with a travelling now-line and a veiled yesterday - CSS-animated river ripples, sluice water, bakery smoke, laundry steam, storm rain and a lightning flash - Hand-drawn SVG controls: knife switches with a sprung blade, a rotary wind knob, a cloud-shaped slider thumb, chunky push buttons, a sun-and-moon day dial

notes.zh: 作者自述：A darkened Victorian parlour: a brass wall lamp flares up at the upper left, throwing a warm pool over patterned wallpaper and a mahogany table on which stands a slotted drum on a turned pedestal. One automatic flick sets it spinning, and within three seconds the bright slits sliding across the near wall fuse into a cream band in which a row of small black-and-vermilion horses gallops on the spot, dimmer and narrower than the drawings on the paper band lying unrolled on the table in front. As the drum coasts down the figure flickers, breaks into sweeping bars with comet tails of drawing, and finally stands as twelve separate slivers. Nothing is faked: the picture is built each frame by sampling the far-wall strip through the moving slits into a persistence buffer that fades like the eye, so the speed, direction and failure of the illusion all follow from how the viewer spins the drum. A reading glass on a stand shows the central figure enlarged; lifting the slotted lid turns the same drawings into a grey smear; and a drawer in the table holds twelve blank frames for a strip of the viewer's own.

tags: - Canvas 2D cylinder rendering: near wall, far inner wall, rim ellipses and brass hoops with cosine-projected slits, staves and frames - Honest slit-scan simulation: each slit's trailing edge paints the opposite strip at twice the angular rate into an offscreen persistence canvas, sub-sampled within every display frame - Persistence of vision as exponential alpha decay (destination-out) tied to real elapsed time, giving natural flicker, lock-in and dissolve - Vertical parallax through the slits (the far wall is seen lower at the centre than at the edges) from the tilted viewpoint - Motion blur proportional to angular speed on far slits and stave seams; multi-sample smear and column-averaged strip when the lid is off - Six procedural twelve-frame strips drawn from articulated shapes and keyframed cycles (gallop, three-ball cascade, somersault, wing beat, waltz turn, squash-and-stretch ball with pulsing star), drawn wide to survive the slit squeeze - Paper texture with grain, frame numbers and registration marks; unrolled band of twelve cells with a travelling vermilion underline - Lathe-turned pedestal and spindle built from stacked gradient slices; brass crank wheel, felt brake pad, reading glass that magnifies the live canvas - Pre-rendered parlour: lamp glow, wallpaper revealed only inside the light, table grain, light pool and cast shadows; flickering flame with additive glow - Entrance choreography: lamp flare, letter-by-letter lighting of the show-card title, band unrolling, automatic flick - Show-card typography: wide-tracked heavy serif capitals in vermilion with a cream outline, italic subtitle, handwritten paper tags, engraved brass plates, SVG speed dial with the sweet band in vermilion - Web Audio whirr and spindle tick that rise with speed (off until switched on)

notes.zh: 作者自述：A bright, sunlit aquarium tank in which the Collatz conjecture is a living plant. The reverse tree of every path from 1 to 9,000 grows out of a sea-urchin "1" on a sandy floor: thick deep-teal trunks through 2, 4, 8 and 16, thinning and paling into thousands of sea-green hairline fronds that lean and curl because even steps bend one way and odd steps the other. The whole forest sways in a slow travelling swell while garibaldi-orange and teal fish weave through it, bubbles rise and marine snow drifts. The page is set like a museum panel: a bold serif title and three plain sentences in the upper left with the rule drawn as a two-branch sprig, a cream instrument plate with a number field, famous starters and two brass dive-gauge dials, a specimen card with the hailstone plot, and a strip of statistics printed on the sand ending in "counter-examples found: 0". The signature moment is following a number home: one orange thread lighting the whole way down through the forest to 1.

tags: - Merged Collatz tree computed in the page and stored in typed arrays, parents always before children so positions resolve in one pass - Turtle-style geometry: per-node cumulative angle (+even, -odd), segment length shrinking with depth, whole form rotated so its centre of mass stands upright and fitted to the viewport by percentile bounds - Canvas 2D rendering batched into width-by-colour buckets; stroke width from the log of the number of sequences through each edge; teal-to-green depth gradient or a pale-to-ink "by height" peak scale - Sway from two travelling sine waves sampled at each parent position, with amplitude growing toward the tips - A spring-damped grid of current values, bilinearly sampled, for the draggable water that bends fronds and lets them swing back - Entrance growth by depth front with a damped-spring overshoot on each newly revealed segment, statistics counting up with it - Orange highlighted path with pale halo, core and inner glint, drawn through the same sway field so it stays fused to the forest; BigInt arithmetic for planted numbers up to 10^12 - Smoothly eased re-fit of scale and root when a planted frond outgrows the forest or the dials reshape it - Procedural fish with wagging tails steered by a flow field and pointer panic; bubbles deflected by a node-density grid; marine snow; skewed drifting light shafts; sand with ripples and specks; SVG grain - SVG brass gauge dials with gradients, ticks, needle and glass highlight; inline hailstone chart on a log scale - Museum-panel typography: bold Georgia title, letterspaced Gill Sans small capitals, tabular lining numerals

title.zh: Hell Box — Wood Type You Can Drop
title.en: Hell Box — Wood Type You Can Drop

notes.zh: 作者自述：A jobbing printer's back room on a cream wall: a red hand-painted HELL BOX sign, a pinned notice from the Foreman, and a steel proofing-press bed framed by wooden furniture. Keys rain end-grain maple sorts onto the bed, each carrying a mirror-reversed letter stained with old ink, and they thud, lean and stack under a small rigid-body engine. Pulling a proof plays the whole press cycle — brayer, sheet, cylinder, peel, flip — and turns the accidental pile into a right-reading letterpress poster with salty ink, slur and deboss, which then flies up to a sagging drying line of pegged, swaying proofs. Overprinting in other inks builds layered chance posters that can be enlarged and saved.

notes.zh: 作者自述：An open field notebook lies on a dark wooden desk. The left page is written up in a sepia italic hand: a title, two dated entries, a labelled pencil sketch of a worker ant from above, a three-step diagram of the two-scent rule, a live tally and an "Observations" log. The right page is the arena, with a pasted typewritten specimen label, a pressed lime leaf, a coffee ring, a ribbon in the gutter and a green pencil lying across the corner. Up to 1,500 ants pour from a drawn nest hole in a fan, find the waiting sugar within seconds, and stain the paper with green home-scent and rust food-scent that thickens into roads. The viewer adds sugar, draws graphite walls, rubs out roads, drops water and inspects individuals under a 4x loupe, while red-pencil notes with arrows write themselves beside notable events and are entered in the log with timestamps.

title.zh: Gemini 4 重构 Chromium 大型代码库
title.en: Applying Gemini 4 for large-scale codebase maintenance in Chromium

notes.zh:
演示什么：Chromium 的代码库有数百万行、积累了几十年；Google 工程师 Erik Chen 用 Gemini 4 Argon 让多个 agent 并行拆解架构、改代码，再由 Chromium 的测试套件与人工代码评审把关。
官方怎么说：视频把重点放在「多个 agent 独立工作、测试与评审兜底」，不是一次生成整库。
边界：这是 Google 内部案例，不是受控基准；视频没有给出提交量、失败率、回滚率或与其他模型的同题对比，不能当作「Argon 能独立维护任意代码库」的证明。
notes.en:
What it shows: Chromium’s codebase is millions of lines and decades old; Google engineer Erik Chen uses Gemini 4 Argon to let multiple agents untangle the architecture and change code, with Chromium’s test suites and human code review as gates.
What the official video says: the emphasis is on multiple agents working independently with tests and review as backstops, not one-shot generation of the whole repository.
Boundary: this is an internal Google case study, not a controlled benchmark; the video does not give commit volume, failure rate, rollback rate or a same-task comparison with other models, so it is not proof that Argon can maintain any codebase alone.

title.zh: Gemini 4 教人形机器人投沙包
title.en: Teaching a humanoid robot to play cornhole with Gemini 4 Argon

notes.zh:
演示什么：Google DeepMind 的机器人团队让 Gemini 4 Argon 看一段人投沙包的视频，模型在 MuJoCo 里搭出虚拟仿真，算出物理与全身控制参数，再交给 Apptronik 的 Apollo 2 人形机器人执行；官方称它在真实世界连续投进 7 球。
官方怎么说：这条 Video-to-Sim-to-Real 流水线把「几周的手工建模」压到「几小时」，目标是让普通视频变成物理 AI 的训练场。
边界：这是内部测试的单个任务，不是跨任务成功率；视频没有给出尝试次数、失败分布、 sim-to-real 偏差或安全边界，不能外推成「人形机器人已通用」。
notes.en:
What it shows: Google DeepMind robotics researchers had Gemini 4 Argon watch a video of a person playing cornhole; the model built a MuJoCo simulation, calculated the physics and whole-body control, and handed them to Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid, which the official video says sank seven consecutive shots in the real world.
What the official video says: this Video-to-Sim-to-Real pipeline compresses weeks of manual modelling into hours, turning ordinary videos into a training ground for physical AI.
Boundary: this is a single internal test task, not a cross-task success rate; the video gives no attempt count, failure distribution, sim-to-real gap or safety envelope, so it does not generalise to “humanoids are solved”.

What it shows: Google Cloud Tech spends forty minutes on ten official demos, spanning 1960s Fortran migration to Rust/C++, autonomous Android UI construction, real-time WebGPU fur, 3D data visualisation, NASA Artemis II trajectories and a napkin sketch turned into 3D-printed hardware.
What the official video says: the team reports 1,000+ hours of hands-on testing and frames Argon’s 1M-token output ceiling plus long-horizon reasoning as the ability to deliver large, verifiable results in one run.
Boundary: this is a curated showcase, not a same-task comparison; successful cases were selected for display and failures/costs are not disclosed item by item, so “all ten ran” is not an average-capability claim.

边界：这是官方用法展示，不是独立评测；文章没有给出每个例子的 prompt、工程文件与失败率，部分素材由 Nano Banana 等其他模型参与，不能全部记在 Argon 头上。
notes.en:
What it shows: Google’s official article lists eight use cases: interactive tools and playable 3D games, lifelike textures, real-time 3D rendering, physics simulation and music visualisation. One example has Argon in Antigravity orchestrate subagents, Blender MCP and Nano Banana to turn photos of a real desk into a playable 3D track.
What the official article says: it stresses Argon’s grasp of real-time 3D, lighting, shading and interactive physics, plus the ability to chain tools into one agent pipeline.
Boundary: this is an official use-case gallery, not an independent evaluation; it does not give each example’s prompt, project files or failure rate, and some assets involve other models such as Nano Banana, so not every result belongs to Argon alone.

notes.zh:
演示什么：Google Antigravity 把 Gemini 4 Carbon 与 /swarm 一起上线。一个 prompt 可以拉起一支分工 agent 团队：规划、构建、验证并行推进，共享一块实时消息板，每个角色还能用不同模型。
官方怎么说：Carbon 负责长程软件工程、知识工作、科学发现与网络安全；/swarm 负责多 agent 编排，解决「单协调者上下文成为瓶颈」的问题。
边界：/swarm 仍是 preview，只有 Google AI Ultra 订阅者可先用；官方没有给出并行 agent 的 token 成本、冲突率、回滚率与独立基准，不能当作「多 agent 一定比单 agent 强」的结论。
notes.en:
What it shows: Google Antigravity ships Gemini 4 Carbon alongside /swarm. One prompt can launch a team of specialised agents that plan, build and verify in parallel on a shared live message board, with different models allowed per role.
What the official article says: Carbon covers long-horizon software engineering, knowledge work, scientific discovery and cybersecurity; /swarm handles multi-agent orchestration and removes the single-coordinator context bottleneck.
Boundary: /swarm is still in preview and limited to Google AI Ultra subscribers; the article gives no token cost, conflict rate, rollback rate or independent benchmark for parallel agents, so it is not a conclusion that multi-agent always beats a single agent.

notes.zh: 北海浮标站的高级仪表盘：大标题“North Sea, translated.”、UTC 时钟、站点坐标和主潮位曲线；24H/7D/30D 切换会重绘曲线并做描边动画，悬停十字线带浮层，潮汐钟和三条 sparkline 遥测卡同步。看点是海洋编辑排版和仪表密度的平衡。边界：潮汐数据是模拟的，不接真实浮标。
notes.en: A premium North Sea buoy dashboard: an oversized “North Sea, translated.” headline, UTC clock, station coordinates and a dominant tide-height chart; 24H/7D/30D redraws the curve with a stroke animation, hover adds a crosshair tooltip, and a tide clock plus three sparkline telemetry cards stay in sync. The craft is nautical editorial layout balanced against instrument density. Boundary: simulated tide data, no live buoy feed.

notes.zh: 一本印刷季刊的天体力学跨页：奶油纸、密排衬线正文、双细线、首字下沉、两端对齐三栏、锈橙与墨蓝；包含目录条、主论文、拉引、十月天象表、月相盘，以及一个可悬停的四行星椭圆轨道仪。看点是印刷排版规则被完整搬进网页。边界：内容为虚构刊物，轨道仪是示意不是星历。
notes.en: A printed quarterly spread on orbital mechanics: cream paper, dense serif columns, double rules, drop caps, justified three-column text, rust and ink-blue; a contents bar, lead essay, pull quote, October sky table, moon-phase plate and a hoverable four-planet elliptical orrery. The craft is carrying complete print typography rules onto the web. Boundary: a fictional issue, and the orrery is illustrative, not an ephemeris.

notes.zh: 植物学笔记本式的生成花园：暖纸底、方格网、深绿墨水和珊瑚色强调；右侧 Canvas 里手绘茎叶和多瓣花从点击处长出，随风摆动，左侧花瓣数滑杆、三套草甸/余烬/暮色调色板、风和“种一株”按钮。看点是让生成结果像标本而不是玩具。边界：生长规则是程序化的，没有植物学模型。
notes.en: A botanical-notebook generative garden: warm paper, graph grid, deep green ink and coral accents; hand-drawn stems, leaves and multi-petal flowers grow from clicks and sway in the wind on canvas, while the left panel offers a petal-count slider, Meadow/Ember/Dusk palettes, wind and “Plant a specimen”. The craft is making output feel like a pressed specimen, not a toy. Boundary: procedural growth, no botanical model.

notes.zh: 把海底地形做成数据艺术：左侧编辑栏有“The map beneath the map.”、实时深度读数、深度滑杆和 Dive 按钮；右侧 SVG 海图由三座海山的数十条同心等深线、经纬网、测深点和站点标记组成，深度地平线随滑杆扫过，下方四个深度带同步高亮。看点是等深线的雕刻感和声呐式扫掠。边界：地形是手写生成的，不是真实测深数据。
notes.en: Seafloor terrain as data art: the left editorial column carries “The map beneath the map.”, a live depth readout, depth slider and Dive button; the right SVG chart builds dozens of concentric contours around three seamounts with graticules, soundings and station markers, while a depth horizon sweeps with the slider and four depth bands highlight below. The craft is engraved-looking isolines and a sonar-like sweep. Boundary: hand-generated terrain, not real bathymetry.

notes.zh: 一台可弹的复古未来合成器：深炭灰面板、象牙标签、十二个发光彩色打击垫、示波器、三根硬件推子、16 步音序器和走带控制；点垫子真的用 WebAudio 合成音符，推子改截止/共振/速度，音序器按节拍走播放头。看点是硬件质感和可用性同时成立。边界：单页合成器，不是完整 DAW 或 MIDI 工作站。
notes.en: A playable retro-futurist synth: charcoal panel, ivory labels, twelve glowing colour pads, an oscilloscope, three hardware faders, a 16-step sequencer and transport; pads synthesize real notes through WebAudio, faders change cutoff/resonance/tempo, and the sequencer runs a moving playhead. The craft is hardware tactility and actual usability at once. Boundary: a single-page synth, not a full DAW or MIDI workstation.

notes.zh: 挑战者深渊的潜水器观测站：Canvas 里半透明水母做正弦波触手与径向光晕，海雪孢子不断上升；两侧毛玻璃 HUD 可选三种发光生物、切换荧光波长，显示压力/深度、海流扰动滑杆，点击还会发出声呐环。看点是发光生物的群体运动和仪表叙事。边界：生态行为是程序化的，不是海洋生物模型。
notes.en: A bathysphere observatory in the Challenger Deep: translucent medusae pulse multi-segment sine tentacles and radial bells through rising marine snow; frosted HUD panels select three bioluminescent species, shift luciferin wavelengths, show pressure/depth, add a current-drift slider and click-triggered sonar rings. The craft is collective glowing motion framed as instrument narrative. Boundary: procedural ecology, not a marine-biology model.

notes.zh: 磁流体 Rosensweig 不稳定性演示：Canvas 上的金属液球按极坐标谐波方程长出尖刺，尖刺方向跟随指针；Obsidian Chrome、24K Gold、Iridium Bismuth 三套高光，特斯拉线圈滑杆把尖刺数从 8 调到 42，点击还能反转极性。看点是镜面金属渐变和动态尖刺。边界：视觉近似，不是磁流体动力学求解。
notes.en: A ferrofluid Rosensweig instability demo: a metallic liquid sphere grows spikes from a polar harmonic equation on canvas, and the spike field tracks the pointer; Obsidian Chrome, 24K Gold and Iridium Bismuth presets, a Tesla-coil slider from 8 to 42 spikes, and click-to-invert polarity. The craft is specular metal shading and live spikes. Boundary: a visual approximation, not magnetohydrodynamics.

notes.zh: 两个耦合布洛赫球之间架一道驻波干涉桥，H、CNOT、Pauli-Z、Measure 四个门会真的改变态矢量；|00⟩/|01⟩/|10⟩/|11⟩ 的概率条实时更新，测量会触发波函数坍缩。看点是量子门操作和双球相位保持同步。边界：教学可视化，忽略噪声、退相干和真实硬件误差。
notes.en: Two coupled Bloch spheres bridged by a standing interference wave; H, CNOT, Pauli-Z and Measure gates actually change the state vector, probability bars for |00⟩/|01⟩/|10⟩/|11⟩ update live, and measurement collapses the wavefunction. The craft is keeping gate operations and both sphere phases in sync. Boundary: a teaching visualization that ignores noise, decoherence and hardware error.

notes.zh: 程序化径向 SVG 玫瑰窗：厚重的黑色铅条、尖拱花瓣、三叶饰和中心圆窗，背后是哥特拱顶的暗色中殿；花瓣对称度 8–24 可调，晚祷光照透明度可调，三套中世纪玻璃配色（沙特尔钴蓝/鲁比、圣礼拜堂紫/玫瑰、兰斯灰彩/祖母绿）。看点是旋转复制和铅条描边的节奏。边界：装饰性几何，不是历史窗样的精确复刻。
notes.en: A procedural radial SVG rose window: heavy black lead cames, lancet petals, trefoils and a central oculus inside a dark vaulted nave; petal symmetry runs 8–24, vespers luminance is adjustable, with three medieval palettes (Chartres cobalt/ruby, Sainte-Chapelle violet/rose, Reims grisaille/emerald). The craft is rotational instancing and leaded-stroke rhythm. Boundary: decorative geometry, not an exact historical reconstruction.

notes.zh: 2,400 颗石英砂在黄铜边框的方形谐振板上振动，按 Chladni 驻波方程 cos(nπx)cos(mπy) − cos(mπx)cos(nπy) 从波腹逃向节点，最终结晶成几何曼陀罗；可在 (3,5)/(4,7)/(2,6) 三组模态间切换并重新撒沙。看点是粒子随机扰动与确定性节点线的对抗。边界：二维理想板，忽略真实板厚、阻尼和扬声器特性。
notes.en: 2,400 quartz grains vibrate on a brass-bordered square plate and migrate from antinodes to nodal lines under the Chladni standing-wave equation cos(nπx)cos(mπy) − cos(mπx)cos(nπy), crystallizing into geometric mandalas; switch between (3,5), (4,7) and (2,6) modes and rescatter the sand. The craft is stochastic particle motion against deterministic nodal lines. Boundary: an ideal 2D plate, ignoring thickness, damping and speaker response.

notes.zh: 把虚构太阳站做成可操作的仪表盘：三路遥测曲线、姿态地平仪、四个推进剂环形表、自动打字的事件日志和通信瀑布同时刷新；侧栏能开关模块，DRILL 会触发整站告警演练，主时钟还能 0.5–3 倍变速。看点是多个异构组件共用一套琥珀色仪表语言，而不是简单堆卡片。边界：数据是前端模拟，没有真实遥测链路。
notes.en: A fictional solar-station dashboard with three telemetry traces, an attitude horizon, four propellant gauges, a self-typing event log and a comm waterfall all live at once; a side rail toggles modules, DRILL runs a station-wide alert, and a master clock retimes everything from 0.5× to 3×. The point is one coherent amber instrument language across heterogeneous widgets, not a pile of cards. Boundary: simulated telemetry, no real downlink.

notes.zh: 拖动耙子会在沙面留下有深度渐变的平行纹路，放下风化石会自动生成环绕的涟漪；三齿/五齿耙、扫帚、风和重置都可操作，手势触发后还有 WebAudio 的沙砾声。看点是 Canvas 离屏轨迹、速度决定刻痕深浅，以及克制的日式庭园动势。边界：石头与沙的交互是程序规则，不是真实颗粒物理。
notes.en: Dragging a rake carves parallel grooves whose depth fades with stroke speed; placing a weathered stone automatically rings it with raked ripples. Three- and five-prong rakes, a broom, wind and reset are all interactive, with gesture-gated WebAudio sand texture. The craft is the offscreen trail canvas, speed-dependent incision and restrained garden motion. Boundary: stone-sand interaction is procedural, not granular physics.

notes.zh: 一座漂浮岛上的糖果色等距小镇：八栋建筑、两条环路、五辆小车、喷泉、街灯和云都由 CSS 3D 平面拼成；昼夜切换会整体换色，窗户按时亮灭，点击建筑弹出居民卡片。看点是纯 CSS 3D 的透视、长阴影和微缩模型感，不靠 Three.js。边界：固定小场景，不能自由建城或真实寻路。
notes.en: A pastel isometric town on a floating island: eight buildings, two looping roads, five cars, a fountain, streetlamps and clouds are assembled from CSS 3D planes; a day/night switch regrades the whole scene, windows light on a rhythm, and clicking a building opens a resident card. The craft is CSS-only 3D perspective, long shadows and toy-diorama feel without Three.js. Boundary: a fixed vignette, not a city builder or real pathfinding.

notes.zh: 夜港上空的烟花设计台：可选牡丹、菊花、柳、环、棕榈、十字裂六种爆型，五种配色和三档弹径；点击天空发射，长按蓄力多级爆，FINALE 编排 20 发齐放，水面还会反射火星。看点是弹道、重力、阻力、余烬衰减和 WebAudio 闷响在同一时间轴上对齐。边界：纯视觉沙盒，没有真实火药或安全模型。
notes.en: A firework design bench over a night harbour: six burst patterns (peony, chrysanthemum, willow, ring, palm, crossette), five palettes and three shell sizes; click the sky to launch, hold to charge a multi-break shell, FINALE choreographs 20 shells, and the water mirrors every spark. The craft is aligning ballistic ascent, gravity, drag, glitter decay and WebAudio thumps on one timeline. Boundary: a visual sandbox, not a real pyrotechnic or safety model.

notes.zh: 一台可用的恩尼格玛复刻：三只历史接线转子（I/II/III，真实 Q/E/V 缺口）、B 反射器、可拖拽接线板和琥珀灯板；按键时右转子步进、到缺口带动中转子，灯板逐字亮起。还有解码模式验证对称性，以及一段说明它为何被破的图文。看点是机械步进、接线和灯板状态真的联动。边界：教学复刻，不覆盖军用密钥规程与所有历史型号。
notes.en: A working Enigma replica: three historically wired rotors (I/II/III with real Q/E/V notches), a B reflector, a draggable plugboard and an amber lampboard; each keypress steps the right rotor and carries at the notch, lighting the ciphertext letter. A decode mode proves symmetry, and an illustrated panel explains why it fell. The craft is genuine mechanical stepping, plugboard and lamp state. Boundary: a teaching replica, not every wartime model or key procedure.

notes.zh: 虚构预测市场经纪终端：呼吸式多径向渐变背景、青色网格、CRT 扫描线和偶发白闪；首屏有故障字标、实时订单流、四列指标、三档服务卡和 shell 终端。看点是高密度信息排版仍保持层级，霓虹色不糊成一片。边界：视觉演示，订单和行情都是模拟数据。
notes.en: A fictional prediction-market brokerage terminal: breathing multi-radial gradients, a cyan grid, CRT scanlines and occasional white flicker; the hero carries a glitch wordmark, live order flow, a four-column metrics strip, three service tiers and a shell panel. The craft is dense information layout that keeps hierarchy instead of melting into neon. Boundary: a visual demo with simulated orders and quotes.

notes.zh: 真正的 metaball 场：低分辨率标量场由多个吸引子的反平方贡献求和，阈值化成等值面，再经四段色带映射到 ImageData 并放大；右侧滑杆调粘度、吸引子数量和流速，调色板和预设会重绘整场。看点是标量场、等值面和镜面高光的分层。边界：二维屏幕空间效果，不是流体方程求解。
notes.en: A real metaball field: a low-resolution scalar field sums inverse-square contributions from several attractors, thresholds into an isosurface, maps through a four-stop ramp into ImageData and upscales; sliders control viscosity, attractor count and flow speed, while palettes and presets retint the field. The craft is scalar field, isosurface and specular sheen layered cleanly. Boundary: a 2D screen-space effect, not a fluid solver.

notes.zh: 虚构深空巡天目录：Canvas 里有约 340 颗各自闪烁的星、银河斜带和漂浮尘埃，六个星座节点用细蓝线连接并带金色脉冲环；指针带来轻微视差，Constellations/Dust/All 三个模式真的切换画布内容。看点是天文插图式的字体、金色与星蓝配色。边界：艺术化星图，不是真实天文坐标或可检索星表。
notes.en: A fictional deep-sky survey: a canvas holds about 340 stars with individual twinkle rates, a diagonal Milky Way band and drifting dust; six constellation anchors are linked by thin blue lines with pulsing gold rings, pointer movement adds slight parallax, and Constellations/Dust/All genuinely switch what the canvas draws. The craft is astronomical-plate typography and gold/starlight-blue palette. Boundary: artistic star map, not real coordinates or a searchable catalogue.

notes.zh: 手写 2:1 等距投影的黄金时刻城市：9×9 地块上生成四个街区，建筑由三块绝对定位 div 组成多边形立面，带窗户、屋顶和高度差；Day/Night/Rebuild 会换天空、灯光并重建城市，信息面板随选区更新。看点是投影数学和 DOM 建筑的细节密度。边界：程序化小城，不是可玩的模拟经营。
notes.en: A hand-projected 2:1 isometric city at golden hour: a 9×9 lot grid generates four districts, each building made from three absolutely positioned divs clipped into facades with windows, roofs and height variation; Day/Night/Rebuild regrades the sky, lights and city, and an info panel follows selection. The craft is projection math and DOM-building detail density. Boundary: a procedural vignette, not a playable city sim.

notes.zh: 黄铜天文仪式的太阳系：内联 SVG 里太阳是径向渐变圆盘，八条轨道环和八颗行星按真实周期比例运动，土星带椭圆环；可暂停、显示轨迹、重置，速度 0.05–3×、尺度 0.5–2×，点行星会更新事实卡。看点是 SVG 分组变换和开普勒周期解释放在同一页。边界：视觉比例经过压缩，不是精确星历。
notes.en: A brass-strument solar system: an inline SVG sun is a radial-gradient disc, eight orbit rings and planets move at proportional real periods, Saturn carries an elliptical ring; pause, trails, reset, speed 0.05–3× and scale 0.5–2×, and selecting a planet updates a fact panel. The craft is SVG group transforms plus a Kepler-period explanation on one page. Boundary: compressed visual scale, not an accurate ephemeris.

notes.zh: 单 Canvas 的螺旋星系：数百颗星体分布在三条对数螺旋臂上，按近圆切向速度整体旋转，中心有软化引力，指针是另一个反平方引力井，会把附近星体拉成涡旋；低透明度逐帧擦除留下光轨。看点是星系旋转和指针扰动的叠加。边界：二维视觉近似，不是真实 N-body 星系模拟。
notes.en: A single-canvas spiral galaxy: hundreds of bodies seeded into three logarithmic arms rotate with near-circular tangential velocity around a softened core, while the pointer acts as a second inverse-square gravity well that warps nearby stars; low-alpha clearing leaves light trails. The craft is galaxy rotation layered with pointer disturbance. Boundary: a 2D visual approximation, not a real N-body galaxy simulation.

notes.zh: 一张和纸在缓慢倾斜的 3D 相机下自动折叠成鹤：朱红菱形身体先抬起，奶白翅膀沿中脊展开，靛蓝脖颈升起并弯头，尾巴最后扫出；每块纸板双面异色，折序有停顿和阴影。看点是 CSS 3D 折纸的次序和纸感。边界：固定折序动画，不能自由折或模拟纸张应力。
notes.en: A washi sheet folds itself into a crane under a slowly tilting 3D camera: a vermilion diamond body lifts, cream wings swing out from the central spine, an indigo neck rises and kinks, and the tail sweeps last; every panel is double-sided with distinct colours, and the sequence has pauses and shadows. The craft is CSS 3D fold order and paper feel. Boundary: a fixed choreography, not free folding or paper-stress simulation.

notes.zh: 一幅立轴水墨竹：三根竹秆从底部墨池升起，一淡两浓，竹节、分枝和点叶都按笔顺逐笔生成；湿墨先有模糊晕染，再收干变锐，最后朱红印章落下并回弹。看点是 SVG/Canvas 笔触的湿边和纸纤维感。边界：程序化笔顺，不是真实毛笔物理或可编辑绘画工具。
notes.en: A hanging-scroll sumi-e bamboo: three culms rise from pooled ink, one faint and two dark, with nodes, branches and leaves painted stroke by stroke; wet ink blooms into a soft halo, then dries sharp, and a vermilion seal drops and settles. The craft is wet-edge ink and rice-paper fibre in SVG/canvas. Boundary: procedural stroke order, not brush physics or an editable paint tool.

notes.zh: 黄铜与星云质感的太阳系仪：深空渐变上有视差星场，中心太阳带旋转日冕和呼吸外晕，八颗行星在同心环上按各自周期运行，悬停显示信息；整体像一枚会转的天文仪器。看点是轨道动画、光晕和排版的统一。边界：视觉比例压缩，不是精确星历或可缩放的真实轨道。
notes.en: A brass-and-nebula orrery: a parallax starfield behind a ringed stage, a pulsing sun with a rotating corona and breathing glow, and eight planets orbiting on concentric rings at their own periods with hover info; the whole reads as a turning astronomical instrument. The craft is orbit motion, glow and typography in one system. Boundary: compressed visual scale, not an accurate ephemeris or true-scale orbits.

notes.zh: 产品式液态铬主视觉：一个 div 用多段银色对角线渐变，靠动画化多值 border-radius 变形成液态团块，叠加扫光、镜面高光和色相循环；背后 Canvas 画流动的铬色光带和青色光点，指针带来平滑倾斜。看点是纯 CSS 形状变形和金属高光。边界：视觉主视觉，不是真实材质渲染。
notes.en: A product-style liquid-chrome hero: a div with multi-stop silver diagonal gradients morphs through animated multi-value border-radius, layered with sweep, specular and hue-rotate highlights; a canvas behind draws flowing chrome light bands and cyan points, and the pointer adds smooth tilt. The craft is CSS-only shape morphing and metallic highlights. Boundary: a visual hero, not physical material rendering.

notes.zh: 科幻驾驶舱 HUD：三层反向旋转的虚线环、脉动核心、角括号面板、扫描线和青色网格；准星跟随指针，方位角/俯仰角由指针位置实时计算，遥测数字持续跳动。看点是 SVG 环、CSS 扫描线与 JS 随机游走在同一视觉系统里。边界：全是模拟仪表，没有真实传感器或飞行状态。
notes.en: A sci-fi cockpit HUD with three counter-rotating dashed rings, a pulsing core, corner brackets, a scanline sweep and a cyan grid; the reticle follows the pointer, azimuth/elevation are computed from cursor position, and telemetry ticks continuously. The craft is SVG rings, CSS scanlines and JS random walks in one visual system. Boundary: simulated instruments, no real sensors or flight state.

notes.zh: 成千上万条细粒子沿伪噪声向量场流动，低透明度逐帧擦除留下木纹般的发光轨迹；指针是局部扰动，把附近流线弯成漩涡，控制条可换配色、流速和重新播种。看点是极少的代码参数撑起持续变化的画面。边界：生成艺术，不是可复现的物理模拟。
notes.en: Thousands of hair-thin particles trace a pseudo-noise vector field; low-alpha frame fading leaves luminous, woodgrain-like trails. The pointer injects a local force that bends nearby streamlines into vortices, while a control strip swaps palettes, flow speed and seed. The craft is a continuously evolving image from very few parameters. Boundary: generative art, not a reproducible physical simulation.

notes.zh: 一个完全用 Web Audio 振荡器合成的生成音乐器：按播放后进入 Am–F–G–Am 的 112 BPM 循环，正弦低音、LFO 颤音铺底、三角波琶音经过滤波延迟；AnalyserNode 的 FFT 驱动 88 根径向频谱条。看点是没有任何音频文件，声音和画面都从代码里长出来。边界：生成式音景，不是可编辑的 DAW。
notes.en: A generative instrument built only from Web Audio oscillators: play starts an Am–F–G–Am progression at 112 BPM with sine sub-bass, LFO-vibrato pads and triangle arpeggios through a filtered delay; an AnalyserNode FFT drives 88 radial spectrum bars. The craft is sound and image both grown from code, with no audio files. Boundary: a generative soundscape, not an editable DAW.

notes.zh: 康威生命游戏的发光版：环形边界让滑翔机永远飞，细胞按年龄从青到紫，死亡留下余晖；可播放/暂停/单步/清空/调速，还能盖章滑翔机、脉冲星和 Gosper 滑翔机枪，暂停时可直接画细胞。看点是 typed array 双缓冲、年龄着色和轨迹衰减。边界：经典二维规则，不是开放世界生态模拟。
notes.en: A glowing Conway’s Game of Life: a toroidal board lets gliders fly forever, cells age from cyan to violet, deaths leave ghost trails; play/pause/step/clear/speed plus stamped glider, pulsar and Gosper gun, and you can paint cells while paused. The craft is typed-array double buffering, age-mapped colour and frame-fade trails. Boundary: the classic 2D rule, not an open-ended ecosystem simulation.

notes.zh: 不是贴图：每帧对 216×122 缓冲区逐像素发射光线，用球面追踪求交有符号距离场——波纹地面和三个漂浮球体，再做 Lambert、镜面、边缘光、距离雾和太阳辉光，最后放大到全屏。可拖动环绕、切三套时段配色、自动旋转，角落显示实测 FPS。看点是 JS 里跑真正的 SDF raymarching。边界：低分辨率上采样，不是 WebGL 光线追踪。
notes.en: Not a texture: every frame casts one ray per pixel into a 216×122 buffer, sphere-traces a signed distance field (a rippled ground and three floating orbs), then shades Lambert, specular, rim light, distance fog and sun glow before upscaling. Drag to orbit, switch three time-of-day palettes, auto-orbit, with measured FPS in the corner. The craft is real SDF raymarching in JavaScript. Boundary: low-res upscaling, not WebGL ray tracing.

notes.zh: 真正的成对 n-body 引力沙盒：每颗天体受所有其他天体和中心恒星按 G·m/r² 加速，位置用积分器更新，身后拖出同色彗尾；深空底上有星云、星场和琥珀中心星。看点是少量天体也能出现混沌轨道和引力弹弓。边界：二维牛顿引力，不含相对论、碰撞合并或真实尺度。
notes.en: A real pairwise n-body gravity sandbox: every body is accelerated by every other body and the central star via G·m/r², positions integrate forward, and each body leaves a same-hue comet trail across a nebula-and-starfield void. The craft is chaotic orbits and slingshots emerging from a few bodies. Boundary: 2D Newtonian gravity, without relativity, mergers or real scale.

notes.zh: 完全用 Web Audio 振荡器搭建的生成音乐器：主增益→低通→压缩器→AnalyserNode，0.07Hz LFO 让滤波持续开合，运行时合成卷积混响；四组“figure”各有根音、五声/小调音阶和四和弦进行，频谱实时驱动画面。看点是没有任何音频文件。边界：生成式音景，不可当作编曲工具。
notes.en: A generative instrument built entirely from Web Audio oscillators: master gain → lowpass → compressor → AnalyserNode, a 0.07 Hz LFO continuously opens and closes the filter, and a convolution reverb is synthesized at runtime; four “figures” carry roots, pentatonic/minor scales and four-chord progressions, with a live spectrum driving the visuals. The craft is zero audio files. Boundary: a generative soundscape, not an arranging tool.

notes.zh: 一座从内部发光的大地晶洞：十六到二十六根六棱柱水晶随机站立，每根有独立色相、三档 HSL 渐变、亮边、内部解理线和尖端高光；暗紫地面、径向渐晕和缓慢光变把空间压成舞台。看点是几何棱柱的层次和矿物感。边界：装饰性场景，不是可切割或可交互的晶体模型。
notes.en: A geode chamber lit from within: sixteen to twenty-six hexagonal crystal prisms stand at random, each with its own hue, three-stop HSL gradient, bright edge, internal cleavage lines and a specular tip; a violet ground, radial vignette and slow light shifts compress the space into a stage. The craft is layered prism geometry and mineral feel. Boundary: a decorative scene, not a cuttable or interactive crystal model.

notes.zh: 一张 Ordnance Survey 风格的虚构地形图：4 像素网格上的 Float64 高度场由五组不同频率/振幅/方向的 sine 波叠加，再加两个固定高斯丘；等高线分两级线宽、80px 经纬网、三角峰标和悬停读数。看点是印刷地图的线稿和地形生成。边界：高度场是程序化的，不是真实 DEM。
notes.en: An Ordnance Survey-style map of imaginary ground: a Float64 heightfield sampled on a 4-pixel grid from five stacked sine waves plus two fixed Gaussian bumps; two-weight isolines, an 80px graticule, summit triangles and hover readouts. The craft is printed-map linework and procedural terrain. Boundary: a synthetic heightfield, not a real DEM.

notes.zh: 3 像素单元的落沙细胞自动机：沙、水、石、火、植物、油六种材料各有不同规则，Uint8Array 自底向上步进，每隔一帧翻转水平扫描方向消除偏移；深色实验台面板和衬线标题把它包装成仪器。看点是极简规则涌现出的堆积、流动和燃烧。边界：二维规则沙盒，不是连续流体或热力学。
notes.en: A 3-pixel-cell falling-sand automaton: sand, water, stone, fire, plant and oil each follow distinct rules, stepped bottom-up over a Uint8Array with horizontal scan direction flipped every other frame to remove drift; a dark lab bench and serif headline frame it as an instrument. The craft is emergence—piling, flow and combustion—from minimal rules. Boundary: a 2D rule sandbox, not continuous fluid or thermodynamics.
