title.zh: 极光玻璃：Stillwater 呼吸应用

notes.zh: Stillwater 呼吸应用的玻璃拟态落地页：午夜蓝底上三层 Canvas 极光带缓慢漂移，星点闪烁；中央呼吸球按 4-7-8 节奏胀缩，并交叉淡入 Inhale / Hold / Exhale；三张功能卡随指针做 3D 倾斜和高光扫过；点球启动一分钟引导，进度环走完；月付/年付用滑动玻璃胶囊切换。看点是 backdrop-filter 磨砂、极光与指针联动，而不是堆半透明卡片。边界：营销页演示，没有真实健康建议或订阅后端。
notes.en: A glassmorphic landing page for the fictional Stillwater breathing app: three canvas aurora ribbons drift over midnight blue and a faint starfield, while a central breathing orb expands and contracts on a 4-7-8 rhythm with cross-fading Inhale / Hold / Exhale captions. Three feature cards tilt in 3D with a moving specular glare, clicking the orb starts a one-minute guided session with a progress ring, and a sliding glass pill toggles monthly/yearly pricing. The craft is backdrop-filter frost, aurora and pointer coupling instead of stacked translucent cards. Boundary: a marketing demo with no real health advice or subscription backend.

notes.zh: 18 世纪黄铜仪器风格的太阳系仪：羊皮纸底、深墨线与黄铜渐变；八颗行星按真实相对周期（水星 0.241 年…海王星 164.8 年）在对数压缩的距离上绕发光太阳运行；外圈是刻度的黄道十二宫环，角落齿轮与模拟时间同步。可拖曲柄倒转/前进时间、用速度盘切换暂停/每天/每月/每年，点行星弹出名称、周期与说明；还有可开关的擒纵滴答。看点是 SVG 机械结构、天文比例和音效在同一件“器物”里。边界：距离经过对数压缩，不是精确星历；日期为模拟值。
notes.en: An 18th-century brass-instrument solar system: parchment, deep ink and brass gradients; eight planets orbit a glowing sun at correct relative periods (Mercury 0.241 y to Neptune 164.8 y) on log-compressed distances, with an engraved zodiac ring and a corner gear train synced to simulated time. Drag the ebony crank to wind time, use the speed dial (pause, day/s, month/s, year/s), click a planet for an ornate cartouche with name, period and description, and toggle a synthesized escapement tick. The craft is SVG mechanism, astronomical ratio and sound in one object. Boundary: distances are log-compressed, not an accurate ephemeris; the date is simulated.

notes.zh: 滚动驱动的马里亚纳海沟下潜：从海面到约 10,935 m，背景依次穿过透光、微光、无光、深渊、超深渊五带；固定深度计同步换算压力（每 10 m 约增加 1 个大气压）、温度与带名；SVG/Canvas 生物按大致深度出现——海豚、水母、抹香鲸、灯笼鱼、吸血乌贼、吞噬鳗、端足类，深处带脉动的蓝绿生物荧光。看点是滚动叙事与科学标尺同步，而不是一张长图。边界：插画化深度与生物分布，不是真实科考数据，滚动位置也不是精确深度。
notes.en: A scroll-driven descent from the ocean surface to the Mariana Trench at about 10,935 m: the background passes through sunlight, twilight, midnight, abyssal and hadal zones while a fixed gauge converts depth to pressure (about one extra atmosphere per 10 m), temperature and zone name. SVG/canvas creatures appear at roughly correct depths — dolphins, jellyfish, a sperm whale, an anglerfish, a vampire squid, a gulper eel, amphipods — with pulsing blue-green bioluminescence deeper down. The craft is scroll narrative synced to a scientific scale rather than one long illustration. Boundary: illustrated depths and ranges, not real survey data, and scroll position is not an exact depth.

notes.zh: 东亚二十四节气日历：一个大圆盘按太阳黄经每 15° 切成 24 段，每段填入对应时节的日本传统色；今天所在的节气由日期计算，并用小太阳标出；选择节气会显示罗马字、汉字、英文释义、近似日期与一段短诗，背后生成花瓣、雨、萤火、落叶或雪的季节动效。看点是数据、传统色与生成动画共用同一个圆盘。边界：节气日期是近似值，不是精确天文历算；传统色对应为设计选择。
notes.en: A contemplative East Asian 24-solar-term calendar: a large SVG dial divides the ecliptic into 24 arcs at 15° intervals, each filled with a traditional Japanese colour for that time of year; today’s term is computed from the date and marked with a small sun. Selecting a term reveals its romanized name, kanji, English meaning, approximate date range and a short poem, while a seasonal motif — petals, rain, fireflies, falling leaves or snow — animates behind the text. The craft is data, traditional colour and generative motion sharing one dial. Boundary: term dates are approximate, not precise astronomical calculation; colour mappings are design choices.

title.en: Lines of Force: Magnetic Field Explorer

notes.zh: 一张纸上的磁场实验台：可放置、拖动条形磁铁（红 N / 蓝 S），场按磁偶极/磁荷计算，三档切换铁屑、带箭头流线与场强热图；小罗盘跟随指针指向局部场；滚轮、R 键或手柄旋转磁铁，双击翻转极性，可增删磁铁。看点是同一份场数据给出三种完全不同的可视化。边界：二维静磁近似，不是完整麦克斯韦方程求解，铁屑分布是视觉采样。
notes.en: A magnetic-field lab on a sheet of paper: place and drag bar magnets (red N / blue S); the field is computed from dipoles or pole charges and rendered three ways — iron filings, arrowed streamlines and a field-magnitude heat map. A small compass follows the pointer and points along the local field; rotate magnets with the wheel, R key or a handle, double-click to flip polarity, and add or remove magnets. The craft is one field dataset expressed as three genuinely different views. Boundary: a 2D magnetostatic approximation, not a full Maxwell solve; filing density is a visual sampling.

notes.zh: 虚构 Mere 港的贝壳商人算盘：象牙色底与桑莓色字，五根水平线上串着偏心高光、轮廓不规则的珍珠，木盒有倒角和木纹；点某根线的位置设定数量，方向键在聚焦线上微调，下方 tally 精确求和。看点是珍珠光泽、木盒质感和交互动效都像一件真实工具。边界：装饰性算盘，不是完整会计系统，数值只用于演示。
notes.en: A shell merchant’s counting board from the fictional harbor of Mere: warm ivory and mulberry, five horizontal wires carrying pearls with off-center highlights and irregular silhouettes inside a beveled wood case. Tap a position on a wire to set its count, use arrow keys on the focused wire, and a tally below records the exact sum. The craft is pearl sheen, wood grain and motion that make it feel like a working instrument. Boundary: a decorative abacus, not a full accounting system; values are for demonstration.

notes.zh: 夜间田野录音装置：左上巨大的 Listen. 字压在深绿叶底，数百根锥形钢笔草叶分层排布；萤火虫缓慢眨眼；点击或按空格在任何位置闪灯，附近萤火虫按距离延迟依次回应，形成一圈圈扩散的合唱；等宽字体记录虚构 Fen Station 的现场笔记。看点是距离延迟、加法光晕与深度剪影。边界：程序化生态，不是真实萤火虫同步模型，响应规则为艺术设计。
notes.en: A nocturnal field recorder: a huge pale-yellow “Listen.” sits upper-left over dark leaf green, hundreds of tapered pen-stroke grasses layer in depth, and lantern insects blink slowly. Click anywhere or press Space to flash; nearby fireflies answer in sequence with distance-based delays, forming expanding rings of chorus, while quiet monospace field notes identify the imagined Fen Station. The craft is distance-delayed pulses, additive halos and depth silhouettes. Boundary: procedural ecology, not a real firefly synchronization model; response rules are designed.

notes.zh: 一张超大风景明信片放在海沫色邮局柜台上：背面有分栏地址、灯塔邮票、手写留言和圆形邮戳；三个海岸邮局按钮会换留言、目的地与编号，邮戳像沉重的日期打孔机一样落到邮票上，纸张随之旋转。看点是 CSS 邮票齿孔、蚀刻灯塔和极少的界面文案。边界：虚构邮局与信件，没有真实邮政数据或寄送功能。
notes.en: An oversized landscape postcard on a seafoam post-office counter: the reverse carries a divided address panel, a perforated lighthouse stamp, a handwritten message and a circular cancellation. Three coastal-office buttons swap the message, destination and serial, and each cancellation drops onto the stamp like a heavy date punch while the paper rotates. The craft is CSS stamp perforation, engraved lighthouse SVG and very little interface copy. Boundary: fictional offices and mail, with no real postal data or sending.

notes.zh: 一张舞蹈动作实验图版：藕粉与桑莓色，舞者沿水平路径完成转体，前面是主姿态，后面叠着半透明的历史姿态；曝光滑杆从单帧拉到整段运动，残影逐渐展开成扇形轨迹；四肢、圆头和裙摆都是矢量剪影，边缘有曝光刻度与不对称标题。看点是多曝光叠加和摄影图版式排版。边界：程序化舞者，不是真实摄影长曝光或动作捕捉。
notes.en: A movement-laboratory plate in dusty rose and mulberry: a dancer travels along a horizontal path while translucent earlier poses stack behind the leading figure; the exposure slider moves from a single frozen pose to a readable fan of motion, with articulated limbs, a circular head and a flared skirt drawn as vector silhouettes. Exposure marks and an asymmetric heading frame the plate. The craft is multiple-exposure compositing and photographic layout. Boundary: a procedural dancer, not real long-exposure photography or motion capture.

notes.zh: 夜车卧铺的窗：厚圆角金属框、靛蓝山丘上的分层绿色极光、半闭的威尼斯百叶；拖动倾斜杆或用触摸/键盘转动叶片，条纹光会逐渐展开成完整地平线；极光几乎不可察觉地流动，系统开启 reduced motion 时保持静止。看点是 CSS 透视叶片、层叠大气渐变和被窗框裁出的景观。边界：景观装置，不是真实车窗、极光预报或列车系统。
notes.en: The window of a night-train sleeper: a thick rounded metal frame, layered green aurora over indigo hills and a partly shut Venetian blind. Drag the tilt lever or use touch/keyboard to rotate the slats until striped light becomes a whole horizon; aurora curtains move almost imperceptibly and hold still under reduced motion. The craft is perspective CSS slats, layered atmospheric gradients and a landscape clipped by the frame. Boundary: a landscape vignette, not a real train window, aurora forecast or rail system.

notes.zh: 实时黄铜与石灰岩日晷年历：中央巨盘刻罗马数字 VI–VI 与拉丁铭文 HORAS NON NUMERO NISI SERENAS；拖外圈时环或滑杆扫过太阳时，晷针按太阳赤纬、时角、高度与方位公式投出锥形阴影，照亮对应的至日/分日双曲线；纬度 -60° 到 +60°、年积日与 Live Solar Time 都可调，Now 回到当前时钟。看点是天文公式真的驱动阴影长度、软硬与石面反光。边界：忽略建筑遮挡与大气折射，纬度/日期是演示参数。
notes.en: A real-time brass-and-limestone horizontal sundial almanac: a monumental dial engraved with Roman numerals VI–VI and the motto HORAS NON NUMERO NISI SERENAS. Drag the outer hour bezel or scrub time and the gnomon projects a tapered shadow from solar declination, hour angle, altitude and azimuth formulas, lighting the corresponding solstice/equinox hyperbola; latitude (-60° to +60°), day-of-year and Live Solar Time are adjustable, with Now snapping to the local clock. The craft is real astronomy driving shadow length, softness and limestone bounce. Boundary: building occlusion and atmospheric refraction are ignored; latitude/date are demo parameters.

notes.zh: 2,840 米深的深海观测窗：全屏 WebGL GLSL 渲染玄武岩烟囱与湍流矿物羽流，Canvas 2D 作为回退；HUD 显示深度、喷口核心 382°C、环境 1.9°C、静水压 28.4 MPa。移动指针扰动海雪，点击/拖动注入冷水涡流，把上升的黑烟剪成卷曲的羽流，同时触发管虫群落与浮游生物的青色生物荧光波。看点是热液羽流、冷涡与发光生态的实时耦合。边界：视觉化科学场景，不是流体或生物学的精确模拟。
notes.en: A deep-ocean viewport at 2,840 m: a full-bleed WebGL GLSL black smoker with turbulent mineral plumes, backed by a Canvas 2D fallback. HUD telemetry shows depth, 382°C vent-core temperature, 1.9°C ambient and 28.4 MPa hydrostatic pressure. Moving the pointer disturbs marine snow; click or drag to inject cold-water vortices that shear the rising smoke into curls and trigger a cyan bioluminescent wave across tubeworm colonies and drifting plankton. The craft is live coupling of plume, cold eddies and glowing ecology. Boundary: a visualized science scene, not an exact fluid or biological simulation.

notes.zh: 一间安静的金缮工作室：青瓷茶碗放在亚麻垫上，点击碗身会掉落并碎成放射/Voronoi 碎片，碎片带冲量和柔和投影；沿每条裂缝拖动指针，像真漆刷一样留下宽度变化的漆线，并撒上闪动的 24K 金粉；所有接缝完成后碗自动收拢，五声音阶陶瓷铃响起，一道斜向高光扫过金线。可换茶碗/盘子/酒壶，音效默认关闭。看点是 Canvas 2D 的碎片物理与笔刷。边界：工艺与视觉演示，不提供真实金缮材料或修复服务。
notes.en: A quiet kintsugi studio: a celadon tea bowl sits on a linen mat; click it to drop and shatter into radial/Voronoi shards with impulse and soft shadows. Drag the pointer along each crack like a fine lacquer brush, leaving variable-width urushi strokes dusted with shimmering 24k gold; when every seam is complete the bowl draws itself together, a pentatonic ceramic chime sounds and a diagonal specular wave sweeps the golden veins. Bowl, plate and sake flask shapes are switchable; sound is off by default. The craft is canvas shard physics and brushwork. Boundary: a craft and visual demo, not real kintsugi materials or a repair service.

notes.zh: 黑暗拱顶下的动力雕塑：24 只独立青铜/琥珀摆锤沿黄铜横梁按透视深度排列，周期被调成 60 秒内完成 51–74 次摆动；相位从一致出发，依次长出行进蛇形、反向双螺旋、三股辫与对立分裂，最后在 60.00 秒回到齐一。可拖 60 秒相位盘、跳转 Unison / Double Helix / Opposition 等节点，切正面/俯视/等距视角，开启管钟后用五声音阶为每次过中点配音。看点是独立摆的相位差如何涌现出整体图形。边界：理想单摆模型，忽略空气阻力、耦合与机械误差。
notes.en: A kinetic sculpture under a dark vault: 24 independent bronze-and-amber pendulums hang in perspective along a brass beam, tuned to complete 51–74 swings within a 60-second cycle. Starting in unison, their phases grow traveling snakes, counter-rotating double helices, three-strand braids and split opposition before snapping back to unison at 60.00 s. Drag the phase dial, jump to Unison / Double Helix / Opposition, switch front/overhead/isometric views, and enable tubular bells for pentatonic strikes at each zero crossing. The craft is whole-body patterns emerging from independent phase. Boundary: ideal pendulum model, ignoring drag, coupling and mechanical error.

notes.zh: 量子光学实验台：单光子从左侧逐个发射，打到右侧磷光屏上，起初像随机散点，随计数 N 增加逐渐累积出明暗干涉条纹；打开琥珀色 Which-Path 探测器，条纹立刻塌缩成两条经典高斯分布，量子态读数从叠加态变成 COLLAPSED MIXTURE。可切单光子/快速流/连续波，调 400–680 nm 波长与缝距，清屏重来；强度直方图实时更新。看点是概率公式 P(y)=cos²(πdy/λL)·sinc²(πay/λL) 真的在驱动落点。边界：教学用二维可视化，忽略真实光学损耗、探测器效率与量子场效应。
notes.en: A quantum-optics bench: single photons fire from the left and strike a phosphor screen on the right, initially looking random but accumulating bright and dark interference fringes as count N grows. Flip the amber Which-Path detector on and the pattern immediately collapses into two classical Gaussian mounds, while the quantum-state readout changes from a superposition ket to COLLAPSED MIXTURE. Switch single-photon/rapid-stream/continuous-wave modes, tune wavelength from 400–680 nm and slit separation, clear the screen, and watch the intensity histogram update live. The craft is the probability formula P(y)=cos²(πdy/λL)·sinc²(πay/λL) actually driving hit positions. Boundary: a teaching 2D visualization, ignoring real optical loss, detector efficiency and quantum-field effects.

title.zh: 柑橘电台：会转的唱片封面
title.en: Citrus Radio: A Record Sleeve That Spins

notes.zh: 一张虚构电台的唱片封面：芥末黄、柿子橙与奶油白，超大压缩字标、带沟槽的 CSS 黑胶、贴纸与不对称分割。播放/暂停让唱片旋转，下一首轮换三首虚构曲目，减少动效时自动静止。看点是印刷感排版、repeating-radial-gradient 做的唱片沟槽，以及完全不依赖外部音频。边界：没有真实音频流或电台内容，曲名只是演示文案。
notes.en: A fictional radio station’s record sleeve: mustard yellow, persimmon and cream, oversized compressed type, a grooved CSS vinyl record, a sticker and an asymmetric split. Play/pause spins the record, Next cycles three invented tracks, and reduced motion holds it still. The craft is print-inspired typography, repeating-radial-gradient grooves and no external audio at all. Boundary: no real audio stream or station content; track names are demo copy.

title.zh: 云图志：会漂移的田野指南
title.en: Atlas of Clouds: A Drifting Field Guide

notes.zh: 一本关于云的虚构田野指南：柔和蓝天、三层模糊 CSS 云缓慢漂移、编辑体大标题与极小的观察笔记；按钮轮换三种云型描述。看点是层叠模糊、空气感渐变和克制到几乎不动的排版。边界：不是气象数据或真实云种分类，只是三段短文与视觉练习。
notes.en: An invented field guide to clouds: a soft blue sky, three layers of blurred CSS clouds drifting slowly, large editorial serif and tiny field notes; a button cycles three cloud descriptions. The craft is layered blur, atmospheric gradient and typography restrained almost to stillness. Boundary: not weather data or a real cloud taxonomy — three short texts and a visual study.

title.zh: 苔与石：三块石头的呼吸
title.en: Moss & Stone: Three Stones, One Breath

notes.zh: 一张正念编辑页：奶油纸底、三块圆角渐变石头靠 inset 阴影叠成平衡塔，苔绿与粉笔色，大标题周围留出大片空白；按钮轮换几句短反思。看点是极简材质的重量感与排版呼吸。边界：短文是氛围写作，不构成心理或健康建议。
notes.en: A mindfulness editorial: cream paper, three rounded gradient stones stacked into a balanced tower with inset shadows, moss and chalk colours, and generous white space around a large headline; a button cycles short reflections. The craft is the weight of minimal materials and typographic breathing room. Boundary: the texts are atmospheric writing, not psychological or health advice.

title.zh: 黄金比例习作：一块赭石矩形
title.en: Golden Ratio Study: One Ochre Rectangle

notes.zh: 一张离线几何习作：赭石色矩形按黄金比例分割，四分之一圆弧与细线标出比例，暖纸底配大号编辑体衬线；按钮旋转构图，让裁切与留白重新分布。看点是比例网格、pigment 色与印刷感细边。边界：视觉习作，不是精确作图或测量工具。
notes.en: An offline geometry study: an ochre rectangle divided by the golden ratio, quarter-circle arcs and hairlines marking the proportion, warm paper and large editorial serif; a button rotates the composition so crops and margins redistribute. The craft is proportional grid, pigment colour and fine print borders. Boundary: a visual study, not a precise drawing or measuring tool.

title.zh: 天象罗盘：选择方向的仪器
title.en: Celestial Compass: An Instrument for Choosing

notes.zh: 一枚虚构的航海罗盘：午夜蓝与古金，同心细圆、菱形双色指针和衬线大字；按钮把指针转过 90°，像在四个方向之间做一次选择。看点是纯 CSS 几何仪器与克制的动效。边界：装饰性罗盘，不指向真实方位，也没有导航数据。
notes.en: An imaginary nautical compass: midnight blue and antique gold, concentric hairlines, a two-tone diamond needle and large serif type; a button turns the needle ninety degrees, like choosing among four directions. The craft is a pure-CSS geometric instrument and restrained motion. Boundary: a decorative compass that points nowhere real and carries no navigation data.

title.zh: 软陶工坊：可以按出指纹的排期台
title.en: Soft Clay Studio: A Schedule You Can Dent

notes.zh: 一间虚构陶艺工作室的新拟态排期台：陶土色页面、七个真实日期胶囊、当天三到四场烧制或课程、缓慢旋转的拉坯轮盘；点日期换列表，点会话让行下沉并显示釉料说明，Book a wheel 按下去给出“Held for you until close”。看点是同色背景上成对的低对比阴影，像压出来的石膏而不是塑料。边界：工作室与排期均为虚构，没有预约后端。
notes.en: A neumorphic scheduling desk for a fictional pottery studio: clay-coloured page, seven real-date pills, three or four firings or classes for the selected day, and a slowly turning wheel. Click a day to swap the list, press a session to sink the row and reveal a glaze note; Book a wheel depresses and answers “Held for you until close”. The craft is paired low-contrast shadows on a clay-matched background, moulded plaster rather than plastic. Boundary: fictional studio and schedule, with no booking backend.

title.en: Species That Are Not Real: A Forage Guide

notes.zh: 一本信纸色的 letterpress 野外图鉴：六种虚构蘑菇，各有钟形、漏斗、层架、珊瑚指、马勃与高墨帽的独立 SVG 轮廓；季节 chips 过滤图版，点开后在侧栏放大，并显示孢子印色。页眉红线与“A work of fiction. Do not use it in the woods.”警告始终可见。看点是编辑设计与每种菌的剪影差异。边界：全部物种与学名都是编的，页面明确禁止用于野外采食。
notes.en: A letterpress-style field booklet in paper tones: six invented mushrooms with distinct SVG silhouettes — bell, funnel, shelf, coral fingers, puff and a tall ink-cap. Season chips filter the plates; opening one enlarges the drawing in a side panel with a spore-print swatch. A red header rule and the warning “A work of fiction. Do not use it in the woods.” stay visible. The craft is editorial layout and genuinely different silhouettes. Boundary: every species and binomial is invented, and the page explicitly forbids foraging use.

title.zh: 十三轮月光：全年月相环
title.en: Thirteen Lights: A Lunar Year Ring

notes.zh: 一枚全年月相环：以 29.530588853 天的平均朔望月、从 2000-01-06 18:14 UTC 起算，把 2026 年每晚画成一个小月相盘；满月用更大的金边标出，页面按模型数出十三次。今日是金色刻度，点月盘或按前后键换日，中央大月相显示月龄、照亮比例与一句观测。看点是近似天文模型真的驱动整圈图形。边界：页面明确写“approximate mean model”，不是精确星历，也不做占卜。
notes.en: A year-long lunar ring: using a mean synodic month of 29.530588853 days from 2000-01-06 18:14 UTC, every night of 2026 becomes a small phase disc; full moons get a larger gold rim, and the page counts thirteen under this model. Today is a gold tick; click a disc or use Prev/Next to change the date, while the large central moon shows age, illumination and a one-line observation. The craft is an approximate astronomical model actually driving the whole ring. Boundary: the page labels itself “approximate mean model” — not an ephemeris, and never a horoscope.

title.zh: 萨布尔腕表：走真实时间的虚构制表页
title.en: Model Sable: A Watch That Keeps Real Time

notes.zh: 一间虚构高级制表商的产品页：黑曜石底、香槟与铂金字，大号 SVG 表盘走本地真实时间，秒针按毫秒连续扫动；六点位小秒盘、月相、动力储存弧与星期窗三组复杂功能，悬停 6° 倾斜、夜盘反转、沙龙城市轮换。看点是表盘、月相与真实时钟共享同一套状态。边界：品牌、型号与沙龙均为虚构，没有购买、预约或结账表单。
notes.en: A fictional maison’s product page: obsidian ground, champagne and platinum type, and a large SVG dial keeping real local time with a millisecond-swept second hand. A six-o’clock subdial, moon phase, power-reserve arc and weekday aperture form three complications; hover tilts the watch six degrees, Night dial inverts it, and the salon city cycles. The craft is dial, moon phase and real clock sharing one state. Boundary: invented brand, reference and salons; there is no purchase, viewing form or checkout.

title.zh: 纸灯夜市：四张会落下的纸票
title.en: Paper Lantern Mile: Four Tickets After Dark

notes.zh: 一条木色夜市摊档：红金纸灯笼轻摆、汤锅冒蒸汽，四家摊各卖一份纯 CSS 食物——竹笼饺子、孜然煤烤串、卷心菜辣汤与冰上水果；点摊落下纸票，写菜名、两行描述和一个温度词，按钮或拖动可沿街平移。看点是暖木、纸与炭火的光池，刻意避开霓虹雨巷的套路。边界：虚构夜市与菜品，没有商户、价格或支付。
notes.en: A wooden night-market row: red and gold paper lanterns sway, soup steam rises, and four stalls each sell a CSS-built dish — steamer dumplings, cumin coal skewers, cabbage-chilli broth and fruit on ice. Clicking a stall drops a paper ticket with an invented dish name, two lines and one warmth word; buttons or dragging pan along the row. The craft is pools of warm wood, paper and coal light, deliberately avoiding the rainy neon alley. Boundary: fictional market and dishes, with no vendors, prices or payment.

title.zh: 第 9 区暴雨：字符雨里的网络控制台
title.en: Rain over Sector 9: A Console Inside Glyph Rain

notes.zh: 一套赛博网络控制台：全屏 Canvas 字符雨（片假名、半角假名、数字、希腊字母与符号），多数青色、每七列一列品红，指针附近字符变纯白；上面叠 12 栏 HUD，含统计行、18 根吞吐柱、半圆延迟表与事件日志。Trigger surge 让雨速与指标一起飙升再回落，Swap spectrum 轮换青/品红、青柠/青与品红/琥珀三套配色。看点是 HiDPI 字符雨、chamfer 面板、渐变发丝边与 RGB 分离故障字。边界：虚构运营商，所有遥测都是随机生成。
notes.en: A cyberpunk network console: full-screen canvas glyph rain in katakana, half-width kana, digits, Greek letters and symbols — mostly cyan, every seventh column magenta, glyphs near the pointer turning white. A twelve-column HUD overlays stat rows, an eighteen-bar throughput histogram, a semicircular latency gauge and an event log. Trigger surge spikes rain and metrics before they decay; Swap spectrum cycles cyan/magenta, lime/cyan and magenta/amber. The craft is HiDPI rain, chamfered panels, gradient hairline borders and RGB-split glitch type. Boundary: a fictional operator; every telemetry value is randomly generated.

title.zh: 捕星机 1983：一台会开机的 CRT 街机
title.en: Starcatcher, 1983: A CRT Cabinet That Powers On

notes.zh: 一台虚构的 1983 街机柜：CRT 从一条亮线展开成 4:3 屏幕，游戏跑在 160×120 离屏缓冲上，整数放大后叠扫描线、RGB 荫罩、滚动亮带与第二层模糊磷光；接金星、吃品红奖励星、躲红岩，连击到 5 与 10 加倍，最高分写进 localStorage。看点是低分辨率像素渲染与机柜材质。边界：虚构游戏与厂商，不是真实街机或模拟器。
notes.en: A fictional 1983 arcade cabinet: the CRT opens from a bright line into a 4:3 screen; the game runs on a 160×120 offscreen buffer, upscaled nearest-neighbour under scanlines, an RGB aperture mask, a rolling bright bar and a blurred phosphor layer. Catch gold stars, grab magenta bonuses, dodge red rocks; chains at five and ten multiply the score, and the high score persists in localStorage. The craft is low-resolution pixel rendering and cabinet materiality. Boundary: an invented game and manufacturer, not a real cabinet or emulator.

title.en: Chaos Bench: A Double Pendulum Lab

notes.zh: 一台深色实验仪器：RK4 以每帧 8 个子步积分标准双摆方程，青色下摆球拖出随速度由青柠转向青色的渐隐轨迹，右侧相位图把 θ1 对 θ2 逐点累积；可调两段臂长、质量比、重力与轨迹长度，拖动摆球设定角度，TWIN 复制一个差 0.001 rad 的玫瑰色摆看两条轨迹发散。看点是数值积分真的驱动轨迹、能量读数与相图。边界：理想双摆，忽略空气阻力、轴承摩擦与弹性。
notes.en: A dark laboratory instrument: RK4 integrates the standard double-pendulum equations in eight substeps per frame; the lime lower bob leaves a trail that fades and shifts toward cyan with speed, while a phase portrait accumulates θ1 against θ2. Arm lengths, mass ratio, gravity and trail length are adjustable; drag either bob to set angles, and TWIN adds a rose pendulum offset by 0.001 rad so the paths visibly diverge. The craft is numerical integration actually driving motion, energy readouts and the phase plot. Boundary: an ideal double pendulum, ignoring drag, bearing friction and elasticity.

title.zh: 五章正弦：滚动出来的彩虹叠印
title.en: Five Movements in Sine: A Scroll-Printed Spectrum

notes.zh: 一本会发声的编辑页——但没有声音：骨纸底上 30 条彩虹正弦线以 multiply 叠印，滚动把振幅从静默推到满弦再落回安静，快速滚动给线条加一层衰减抖动，指针制造局部高斯压力波；五个全屏章节配大号 Didone 斜体与等宽读数。看点是叠色像油墨、滚动像作曲。边界：生成视觉，不是音频分析或真实频谱。
notes.en: An editorial page that behaves like music without sound: thirty rainbow sine lines overprint on bone paper in multiply mode; scrolling pushes amplitude from hush to full voice and back, fast scrolling adds a decaying shiver, and the pointer creates a local Gaussian pressure ripple. Five full-height movements pair large Didone italics with monospace readouts. The craft is ink-like overprinting and scroll-as-composition. Boundary: generative visuals, not audio analysis or a real spectrum.

title.zh: 月相历书：一整月的银与靛
title.en: Selenographic Almanac: A Month in Silver and Indigo

notes.zh: 一页印刷历书：羊皮纸与靛蓝，整月每晚一枚小 SVG 月相，满月与新月带金色小标签；点选某夜后，左侧大月亮沿最短路径补间，明暗界线真的扫过，maria 与环形山只出现在受光面。下方给出照亮比例、月龄与距下次满/新月的天数，配虚构月名和一句短诗。看点是单路径月相几何与历书排版。边界：用平均朔望月近似，不是天文台星历。
notes.en: A printed almanac page: parchment and indigo, with a small SVG moon for every night of the month and gold tags on full and new moons. Selecting a night tweens the large left-hand moon along the shortest path, sweeping the terminator; maria and crater rings appear only on the lit limb. Below sit illumination, age and days to the next full or new moon, plus an invented moon name and a short verse. The craft is single-path phase geometry and almanac typography. Boundary: a mean-synodic approximation, not an observatory ephemeris.

title.en: Aurora TD-770: A Deck That Actually Transports

notes.zh: 一台 1980 年代风格的虚构卡座：木纹房间、拉丝金属机身与四角螺丝，深色磁带窗里两个 conic-gradient 卷盘、横跨的磁带线与微微歪斜的奶油手写标签；下方四位计数器、16 段双通道 VU 与六个会下沉的机械键。播放走带、暂停冻结、停止归零，Prev/Fwd 跳轨，Eject 翻面并换标签，所有状态由一个 250ms 定时器推进。看点是 animation-play-state 与 LED 峰值保持。边界：没有真实音频，VU 是程序电平。
notes.en: A 1980s-style fictional deck: a wood-dark room, brushed-metal chassis with four corner screws, and a deep tape window holding two conic-gradient reels, a tape line and a slightly crooked cream handwritten label. Below are a four-digit counter, sixteen-segment two-channel VU strips and six mechanical keys that sink when pressed. Play transports, pause freezes, stop resets, Prev/Fwd jump tracks, Eject flips the side and cross-fades the label, all advanced by one 250 ms interval. The craft is animation-play-state transport and LED peak-hold. Boundary: no real audio; the VU levels are generated.

title.zh: 深夜售货机：投币、选货、听它落下
title.en: Vending Machine: Coin, Select, Hear It Drop

notes.zh: 一台红搪瓷售货机：玻璃货窗里九排商品，每排一条 repeating-linear-gradient 螺旋弹簧、一个纯 CSS 商品圆盘与价格，右侧绿色 CREDIT 与 $1/$2/$5 投币键，下方深色取物槽和翻板。投币后选得起的商品，弹簧转两圈、商品按重力落下并小弹一下、翻板抬起，状态行逐段播报；退币清零，余额可留到下一单。看点是纯 CSS 商品与机械动作的因果。边界：虚构商品与货币，没有支付、库存或真实出货。
notes.en: A red-enamel vending machine: nine product rows behind glass, each with a repeating-linear-gradient helix coil, a pure-CSS product disc and a price; a green CREDIT readout and $1/$2/$5 coin keys sit on the right, with a dark delivery chute and hinged flap below. Insert credit, choose an affordable item, and the coil winds twice, the product falls with gravity and a small bounce, the flap lifts, and the status line narrates each stage. Return coin clears the meter; change stays for the next purchase. The craft is pure-CSS merchandise and mechanical cause and effect. Boundary: fictional products and currency, with no payment, stock or real dispensing.

title.zh: 波纹水槽：拖一拖波源，干涉就重排
title.en: Ripple Tank: Drag a Source, Rearrange the Fringes

notes.zh: 一座俯视的物理水槽：720×400 的 ImageData 波场，最多四个琥珀波源，按 sin(kr−ωt+φ)/√r 叠加后映射成波峰增强的青白水光；可拖波源、调波长 18–80px、速度 0–3×、源数 1–4，切换实时波纹与时间平均的 nodal lines，冻结相位慢慢看。看点是逐像素干涉真的随拖动重组。边界：二维线性波近似，不是真实水槽或流体求解。
notes.en: A top-down physics tank: a 720×400 ImageData wave field with up to four amber emitters, summed as sin(kr − ωt + φ)/√r and mapped through a crest-boosted teal-white palette. Drag emitters, set wavelength 18–80 px, speed 0–3× and source count 1–4, switch between live ripples and a time-averaged nodal-line view, or freeze the phase for inspection. The craft is per-pixel interference reorganizing under your hand. Boundary: a 2D linear-wave approximation, not a real tank or fluid solver.

title.zh: 等距岛：十四块 CSS 挤出的模型
title.en: Isometric Island: Fourteen Extruded CSS Blocks

notes.zh: 一座等距建筑模型：十四块体由 JS 数据表生成，每块三个面——顶面抬高、南面与西面各自旋转 90°——拼出水面、沙台、草阶、灯塔、船屋、三棵松、码头、信号岩、小艇与仓库。悬停选中并抬升 16px，右侧面板给出名称、描述、标签与坐标范围；夜景、轨道与线框三种模式。看点是 preserve-3d 下的真实三面着色。边界：示意模型，不是 GIS、建筑测量或可编辑的 3D 编辑器。
notes.en: An isometric architectural model: fourteen volumes generated from a JS data table, each built from three faces — a top translated to height, a south face rotated 90° on the footprint edge, and a west face rotated 90° on the left edge — forming water, sand shelf, grass terrace, lighthouse, boathouse, three pines, dock, signal rock, skiff and storehouse. Hover selects a block and lifts it 16 px; the side panel shows name, description, tags and elevation range, with Night, Orbit and Wireframe modes. The craft is genuine three-face shading under preserve-3d. Boundary: a diagrammatic model, not GIS, survey data or an editable 3D editor.

title.zh: 三球弹珠台：线段碰撞与真实踢力
title.en: Pinball Table: Segment Collisions and Real Kick

notes.zh: 一台 420×660 的 Canvas 弹珠台：深青绒布、炭黑机柜、6px 钢边与斜向玻璃反光；线段-圆碰撞同时用于导轨、弹弓与两片橙色挡板，挡板只在角度仍在变化时施加踢力；掉目标全清后奖励倍数翻倍到 8×，三球耗尽重置，最高分保留，NUDGE 给随机冲量。看点是简化物理里仍保留了挡板的角速度。边界：二维近似，不是真实弹珠台复刻。
notes.en: A 420×660 canvas pinball table: deep teal felt, a charcoal cabinet, a 6 px steel bezel and a diagonal glass sheen. Segment-versus-circle collision serves rails, slingshots and both orange flippers; the flipper only applies kick while its angle is still moving. Clearing the drop-target bank doubles the bonus up to 8×; three drains reset the game while the high score persists, and NUDGE adds a random impulse. The craft is simplified physics that still respects flipper angular velocity. Boundary: a 2D approximation, not a reproduction of a real table.

title.zh: 空月轮盘：二十九个刻槽的月相
title.en: Null Moon: A Twenty-Nine-Detent Phase Wheel

notes.zh: 一枚黑石月轮：近黑场里只有这一个物体，二十九个刻槽对应一套虚构历法的二十九夜；拖动轮盘旋转，松手吸附到最近刻槽，带一次轻微过冲与黄铜指针的回响（无声）。SVG 用暗盘滑过象牙盘，得到正确的蛾眉、上下弦、凸月与满月；中央大号 Georgia 数字与斜体月名。看点是 detent 吸附与石材渐变。边界：虚构历法，不是真实月相、日期或天文计算。
notes.en: A black-stone lunar wheel: one object in a near-black field, with twenty-nine engraved detents for an imaginary calendar’s twenty-nine nights. Drag the wheel and release; it snaps to the nearest stop with a small overshoot and a silent brass-pointer ring. An SVG ivory disc partly covered by a dark disc produces correct crescent, quarter, gibbous and full silhouettes, while a huge Georgia numeral and italic phase name sit at the centre. The craft is detent snapping and stone-gradient material. Boundary: an invented calendar, not real phases, dates or astronomy.

title.zh: 纸板太阳系：用滚动折出来的模型
title.en: Cardboard Cosmos: An Orrery Folded by Scroll

notes.zh: 一件虚构的邮购纸板太阳系仪：牛皮纸、墨蓝、奶油与一点珊瑚红，240vh 滚动把平面印刷卡纸折成七颗纸行星的立体模型，70% 处又折回邮寄纸箱，末尾再弹开；也可拖右侧折痕标尺。悬停行星显示直径与虚构邮费，太阳翼片最后穿过插槽锁定。看点是单一滚动参数驱动整套 3D 折叠。边界：虚构商品，行星数据与装配说明都是编的。
notes.en: An imaginary mail-order paper orrery: kraft, ink blue, cream and one coral accent; a 240vh scroll folds a flat printed sheet into seven paper planets on curved arms, collapses into a mailing carton at 70%, then springs open again. A printed fold gauge on the right can be dragged instead. Hovering a planet shows diameter and an invented postal surcharge; the sun tab finally slides through its slot and locks the assembly. The craft is one scroll parameter driving a whole 3D fold. Boundary: a fictional product; planet facts and assembly notes are invented.

title.zh: 海底图书馆：会变成气泡的句子
title.en: The Submarine Library: Sentences That Rise as Bubbles

notes.zh: 一间深靛蓝海底阅读室：六层书架各四本书，书脊带黄铜细带与虚构书名，在水流里轻轻漂动；点开一本书，单词从书页升起成青色气泡，以不同速度摇上水面，到顶后逐词拼成一句。右侧压力表每开一本升 1 米，CLEAR SURFACE 清掉句子。看点是气泡物理与逐词组装。边界：虚构书目与句子，不是真实图书或借阅系统。
notes.en: A deep-indigo underwater reading room: six shelves of four books each, spines with brass bands and invented titles, drifting slightly in the current. Open a book and its words rise as aqua bubbles, wobbling upward at different speeds; at the surface they assemble word by word into a sentence. A pressure gauge rises one metre per opened book, and CLEAR SURFACE resets the sentence. The craft is bubble physics and word-by-word assembly. Boundary: fictional titles and sentences, not a real library or lending system.

title.zh: 夜班公交 090：用线画出来的时刻表
title.en: Night Service 090: A Timetable Drawn in Thread

notes.zh: 一张深青、柠檬黄与纸色的夜班公交图：四条路线用彩色线连接小站，载入后三秒内线自己画出来，上方翻牌目的地咔哒三次停在 LAST LIGHT；悬停站点看发车时间，点站从上一站延伸亮线并写入右侧时刻表，R 重置。看点是 SVG dash 绘制与机械翻牌的节奏。边界：虚构线路与时刻，不接实时公交数据。
notes.en: A night-bus diagram in deep teal, lemon and paper: four routes drawn as coloured threads between small nodes; on load the threads draw themselves over three seconds while a roll sign clicks through three destinations and settles on LAST LIGHT. Hover a node for departure time, click it to extend a bright thread and append the stop to the timetable, and press R to reset. The craft is SVG dash drawing and the rhythm of a mechanical roll sign. Boundary: fictional routes and times, with no live transit data.

title.zh: FORM 杂志封面：把印刷排版搬进网页
title.en: FORM: A Print Magazine Cover, Rebuilt in CSS

notes.zh: 一张虚构独立设计杂志《FORM》的封面：暖新闻纸、朱红与黑色分隔线，超大紧排无衬线刊头、文学衬线标题、不对称三栏与一个 CSS 几何雕塑。悬停雕塑会重新裁切几何关系；打开编辑手记按钮，展开一段完整文章并带无障碍展开状态。看点是印刷层级、硬阴影和移动端折叠。边界：杂志、文章与刊期均为虚构，没有真实订阅或 editorial 内容。
notes.en: A fictional independent design magazine cover, FORM: warm newsprint, vermilion and black rules, an oversized tightly tracked sans masthead, literary serif headlines, an asymmetric three-column spread and a CSS geometric sculpture. Hovering the sculpture reframes its geometry; the editor’s-letter button opens a full article with an accessible expanded state. The craft is print hierarchy, hard shadows and a deliberate mobile collapse. Boundary: the magazine, articles and issue are invented; there is no real subscription or editorial content.

title.zh: 不寻常事务所：粗野主义作品集封面
title.en: Unusual Practice: A Brutalist Portfolio Cover

notes.zh: 一个虚构设计工作室的作品集封面：混凝土灰、压缩感极强的双行刊头、朱红圆形档期贴纸和粗规则线；三块项目图分别用巨大斜箭头、旋转电蓝字与条纹光学球。All / Identity / Digital / Objects 四个筛选会真实改变项目与计数，箭头悬停改变角度。看点是高密度 grotesk 排版和不对称网格。边界：工作室、项目与档期都是虚构，筛选只在前端。
notes.en: A fictional studio’s portfolio cover: concrete grey, a compressed two-line masthead, a vermilion circular availability sticker and heavy rules; three project tiles use an enormous diagonal arrow, rotated electric-blue type and a striped optical sphere. The All / Identity / Digital / Objects filters genuinely change projects and counts, and the arrow shifts angle on hover. The craft is dense grotesk typography and an asymmetric grid. Boundary: studio, projects and availability are invented; filtering is client-side only.

title.zh: 千愿灯夜：写下愿望，放一盏灯
title.en: One Thousand Wishes: Write a Wish, Release a Lantern

notes.zh: 一场虚构的夜间灯会：梅黑、余烬橙与暖金，中央巨大衬线祈愿句、朱红愿望封签、五盏大小不一的 CSS 纸灯与低矮山影。输入一句短愿，页面会升起一盏新灯并更新本地计数；愿望不发送、不持久化。看点是纸灯径向渐变、骨架纹理和漂浮层次。边界：象征性互动，不是宗教仪式或真实纪念活动；所有内容只留在当前页面。
notes.en: A fictional night lantern festival: plum black, ember orange and warm gold, with a monumental serif invocation, a red-bordered wish seal, five CSS paper lanterns at different scales and a low mountain silhouette. Type a short wish and the page releases another lantern, updating a local count; the wish is never sent or persisted. The craft is radial paper glow, ribbed texture and floating depth. Boundary: a symbolic interaction, not a religious rite or real memorial; everything stays in the current page.

title.zh: 超立方体：把第四维转给你看
title.en: Beyond the Cube: A Tesseract You Can Rotate

notes.zh: 一件四维几何展品：Canvas 画出 16 个顶点与 32 条边，先在 XW 平面旋转，再从 4D 投影到 3D、再投到屏幕；磷光绿线框、描边大标题、右上角对象统计与底部旋转台。拖动角度滑杆或开启自动旋转，能看清超立方体的内外嵌套。看点是两段投影真的共用一套矩阵。边界：数学投影与视觉化，不是物理上的四维物体。
notes.en: A four-dimensional geometry exhibit: canvas draws all 16 tesseract vertices and 32 edges, rotates them in the XW plane, then projects 4D to 3D and onto the screen. Phosphor-green wireframes, an outlined title, object stats and a bottom rotation dock frame it. Scrub the angle slider or enable autorotation to see the inner and outer cubes nest. The craft is two-stage projection sharing one matrix pipeline. Boundary: a mathematical projection and visualization, not a physical 4D object.

title.zh: 字体铸造所：把一句话变成活字标本
title.en: Letter Foundry: A Sentence as a Living Specimen

notes.zh: 一间酸黄纸上的字体实验室：巨大实时标本字、严格铸造厂式控制条、四套系统字体声音、字距滑杆、斜体开关与反色主题；输入自己的句子，字符数、基线参考线和标本标签同步更新。看点是系统字体对比与瑞士网格纪律。边界：只用系统字体，不是可下载的商业字库，也不做字体授权。
notes.en: A type laboratory on acid-yellow paper: an enormous live specimen, a strict foundry control strip, four system-font voices, letter-spacing slider, italic toggle and inverted theme. Type your own sentence and the character count, baseline guides and specimen labels update together. The craft is system-font contrast and Swiss grid discipline. Boundary: system fonts only; this is not a downloadable commercial typeface or a font licence.

title.zh: 水银：会融合分裂的液态金属
title.en: MERCURY: Liquid Metal That Merges and Splits

notes.zh: 一块全屏液态金属习作：5–7 个水银体在炭黑地面上漂移、融合、分离，逐像素计算 metaball 场与解析梯度，再用一维环境查找表伪造铬面反射、地平线亮带、菲涅尔边缘与高光；指针会吸引金属，点击最多加到 12 滴。画面自适应分辨率，R 重新播种，空格暂停；标题用 difference 混合像被金属穿过。看点是实时逐像素着色与性能自适应。边界：伪造的物理与材质，不是流体求解；水银只是视觉隐喻。
notes.en: A full-screen liquid-metal study: five to seven mercury bodies drift, merge and split over charcoal, computing a per-pixel metaball field and analytic gradient, then faking chrome reflection, a razor horizon band, Fresnel rim and specular from a one-dimensional environment LUT. The pointer attracts the metal; clicks add droplets up to twelve. Resolution adapts to frame time, R reseeds and Space pauses; the difference-blended title looks poured through the metal. The craft is real-time per-pixel shading and adaptive quality. Boundary: faked physics and material, not a fluid solver; mercury is a visual metaphor.

title.zh: 小子午线：一座会亮灯的等距街区
title.en: Little Meridian: An Isometric Block That Lights Up

notes.zh: 一座粉彩等距街区：CSS 长方体拼出建筑、街道、树木和霓虹招牌，窗户随机亮起暖光，太阳投下会摆动的长影，发光汽车绕街行驶；悬停或聚焦建筑会抬起并显示名称、层数与用途，另有暂停、下雨与时间跳跃控制。看点是 CSS 3D 体块、昼夜光照与可读的城市信息。边界：虚构街区，不是 GIS 或真实城市规划。
notes.en: A pastel isometric city block: CSS cuboids build the buildings, streets, trees and a neon sign; windows flicker warm, long shadows swing with a simulated sun, and glowing cars circle the block. Hover or focus a building to lift it and read its name, floor count and purpose, with pause, rain and time-skip controls. The craft is CSS 3D massing, day-night light and readable city information. Boundary: a fictional block, not GIS or real urban planning.

title.zh: 子午线公报：一张 1926 年的头版
title.en: The Meridian Gazette: A 1926 Front Page

notes.zh: 一张虚构 1926 年大报的头版：深色木桌上铺着泛黄纸，咖啡环、潮痕、纸纹与随机折痕让每张“印张”都略有不同；黑体报头、通栏新闻、网线雕刻插图、天气与行情框、分类广告，以及一枚歪着砸下的红色“Late Edition”印章。悬停标题会有墨迹渗开又收干，行情数字轻微跳动，分类广告像被钉住一样翘起。看点是多层纸材质、分栏排版与印刷细节。边界：报纸、日期、新闻与人物均为虚构，不是历史档案。
notes.en: A fictional 1926 broadsheet front page on a dark desk: aged paper, coffee rings, damp patches, grain and randomized folds make every “impression” slightly different. A blackletter masthead, justified columns, a hatched engraving, weather and market boxes, classifieds and a red Late Edition stamp slammed down at an angle. Hovering a headline lets ink bleed into the paper and dry back; market figures twitch and classifieds tip up as if pinned. The craft is layered paper, multi-column typesetting and print detail. Boundary: paper, date, stories and people are invented, not a historical archive.

title.zh: 全息演唱会票：可以撕下的副券
title.en: Nova Syndicate: A Holographic Ticket You Can Tear

notes.zh: 一张虚构 synth-pop 演出的超大全息门票：茄紫舞台雾、3D 倾斜、彩虹箔与眩光随指针扫过，副券沿穿孔被真实撕下并以物理抖动翻落。看点是透视倾斜、遮罩箔片与撕裂阻力。边界：演出、艺人、场馆与票价均为虚构，不是可入场凭证。
notes.en: An oversized holographic ticket for a fictional synth-pop act: aubergine stage haze, 3D tilt, rainbow foil and glare sliding under the pointer, and a stub that can be physically torn along its perforation and tumbles with a jittery flop. The craft is perspective tilt, masked foil and tearing resistance. Boundary: act, venue, date and price are invented; this is not a valid admission ticket.

title.zh: MS-2 双音合成器：能弹的两排键
title.en: MS-2 Duet: A Playable Mini Synth

notes.zh: 一台胡桃木与拉丝铝面板的桌面合成器：两八度键盘、四种振荡器波形、detune 与 glide、ADSR 包络图、带响应曲线的谐振低通、LFO、示波器与主音量；鼠标、触摸或电脑键盘都能发声，旋钮可拖动。看点是 Web Audio 合成的完整信号链。边界：软件乐器，不是硬件复刻；没有外部采样或商业音色库。
notes.en: A desktop synth in walnut and brushed aluminium: a two-octave keyboard, four oscillator shapes, detune and glide, an ADSR with live envelope graph, a resonant low-pass with computed response curve, LFO, oscilloscope and master volume. Mouse, touch or computer keys sound notes, and knobs drag like hardware. The craft is a complete Web Audio signal chain. Boundary: a software instrument, not a hardware clone; no external samples or commercial sound library.

title.zh: 灯塔：纯 CSS 画出的黄昏海角
title.en: Cape Verity Light: A Lighthouse in Pure CSS

notes.zh: 一座纯 CSS 的黄昏灯塔：深青到珊瑚的天幕、低垂日轮、闪烁星点、分层漂移云、红白条纹塔身与会旋转的锥形光束，三层不同速度的海浪和剪影海鸥；悬停灯室增亮，黄铜拉杆 checkbox 切换昼夜。看点是零 JavaScript 的完整场景与 vmin 响应式。边界：插画，不是航海图或真实灯塔资料。
notes.en: A lighthouse at dusk drawn entirely in CSS: a deep-teal to coral sky, a low sun sliver, twinkling stars, layered drifting clouds, a red-and-cream striped tower and a rotating conic beam, three wave layers at different speeds and gull silhouettes. Hovering the lantern brightens the beam; a brass checkbox lever toggles day and night. The craft is a complete scene with zero JavaScript and vmin scaling. Boundary: an illustration, not a nautical chart or real lighthouse record.

title.zh: 营地最后的光：Doom 火焰像素画
title.en: Last Light at Camp: A Doom-Fire Pixel Scene

notes.zh: 一幅 240×135 的低分辨率像素夜景：用经典 Doom fire 热缓冲区向上传播火焰，16 级黑到白的调色板，Bayer 抖动天空、月亮、松林、帐篷与烤棉花糖的小人；火星上升，火光会真实照亮附近地面。点击添柴让火势上涨，按住吹气可改变风向，音效默认关闭。看点是低分辨率像素与元胞火焰。边界：视觉玩具，不是真实露营或防火指南。
notes.en: A 240×135 low-resolution pixel night: the classic Doom-fire heat buffer propagates flame upward through a sixteen-step black-to-white palette, under a Bayer-dithered sky, moon, pine silhouettes, tent and a marshmallow-toasting character. Sparks rise and the firelight genuinely modulates nearby ground. Click to throw a log and surge the fire; hold to blow; crackle audio is off by default. The craft is chunky pixel art and cellular fire. Boundary: a visual toy, not real camping or fire-safety guidance.

title.zh: 结构与节奏：瑞士国际主义海报

notes.zh: 一张巴塞尔声音设计节海报：纸白、瑞士红、黑与中灰，12 栏网格线可见，巨大「26」被页边裁切，同心细圆环以不同速度旋转，红盘按真实秒数绕行；日程表的红条跟随悬停行，点红盘反色，数字键 1–4 切换四种版式。看点是严格基线、无圆角无渐变和实时秒针。边界：虚构音乐节与节目单，不是真实活动。
notes.en: A Basel sound-design festival poster: paper white, Swiss red, black and grey; a visible twelve-column grid, an enormous “26” cropped by the page edge, concentric hairline rings rotating at different speeds and a red disc orbiting one ring in real seconds. The schedule’s red bar follows the hovered row, clicking the disc inverts the palette, and keys 1–4 switch four layouts. The craft is strict baseline, no gradients, no rounded corners and a live second hand. Boundary: fictional festival and programme, not a real event.

title.zh: 混凝土与光：建筑事务所的日照研究
title.en: MONOLITH: Concrete, Light and a Moving Sun

notes.zh: 一间虚构建筑事务所的品牌页：混凝土灰、信号橙、厚重压缩字、板模纹理与对拉螺栓孔；「Time of day」滑杆让太阳沿弧线移动，投影多边形随之变长变短，墙面与天空色调一起变化；项目索引悬停展开生成式立面图，滚动有板块视差，曝光开关可整页反色。看点是 CSS/SVG 日照几何与建筑排版。边界：事务所、项目与数据均为虚构，不是可施工图纸。
notes.en: A fictional architecture studio’s brand page: concrete greys, signal orange, heavy condensed type, board-formed texture and tie-hole patterns. A “Time of day” slider moves the sun along an arc; shadow polygons lengthen and shorten while wall and sky tones shift. The project index expands a generative elevation on hover, slabs parallax on scroll, and Exposure inverts the page. The craft is CSS/SVG sun geometry and architectural typography. Boundary: studio, projects and numbers are invented; not construction drawings.

title.zh: 孟菲斯游乐场：拖拽出一张海报
title.en: Memphis Playground: Drag Your Own Poster

notes.zh: 一台 1980 年代孟菲斯风格海报机：大画布上散落可拖拽的波浪线、锯齿、三角、半圆、点阵、棋盘格、闪电与彩纸屑，默认标题 HELLO WORLD 可实时改写，多层硬阴影做出立体字；形状可旋转、双击换色、删除，Shuffle 用弹簧动画重新排布，背景图案可切换，Save PNG 在本地导出。看点是可编辑的 SVG 构图与玩具感物理。边界：所有图形与文案都在浏览器内，不上传云端。
notes.en: A 1980s Memphis-style poster maker: a large canvas scattered with draggable squiggles, zigzags, triangles, half-circles, dot grids, checkerboards, lightning bolts and confetti; the default HELLO WORLD headline is editable and built from stacked hard shadows. Shapes rotate, double-click to cycle colour, delete, Shuffle with spring physics, background pattern chips switch, and Save PNG exports locally. The craft is editable SVG composition and toy-like physics. Boundary: all shapes and text stay in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

title.zh: 粗野主义海报：既是海报也是门票
title.en: Brutalist Poster: The Poster Is the Ticket

notes.zh: 一张虚构混凝土诗歌节的海报：黑底纸板、粗黑规则线、巨型 grotesk 标题、旋转红条、riso 套印画布与票根侧栏；错位红蓝字层和油墨密度滑杆会实时重绘画布，标签页切换宣言、阵容与工作坊，盖章按钮会扣减座位计数并把票根贴到墙上。看点是套印错位与票据感交互。边界：节日、阵容、座位均为虚构，计数只在前端。
notes.en: A fictional concrete-poetry festival poster: a paper panel on black, heavy rules, a giant grotesk headline, a rotated red stripe, a riso-printed canvas and a ticket-stub sidebar. Offset red/blue layers and an ink-density slider redraw the canvas live; tabs switch manifesto, lineup and workshops; the stamp button decrements a seat counter and appends the stub to a wall. The craft is misregistration and ticket-like interaction. Boundary: festival, lineup and seats are invented; the counter is client-side only.

title.zh: 活地形：能用指针捏的等高线
title.en: Morphing Mesh: A Topography You Can Sculpt

notes.zh: 一张苔绿底上的活地形图：Canvas 逐格计算高度场并画成 cell-shaded 网格与等高线，余烬橙到青色的高程色带、跟随指针的测量准星；移动指针读取高程，按住拖动会抬起地形，沙丘 / 山峰 / 火山口三种高度函数、起伏 / 风 / 网格滑杆与静止风按钮。看点是实时高度场与测量式界面。边界：生成地形，不是真实 DEM 或地理测绘。
notes.en: A living contour map on moss-dark ground: canvas computes a per-cell height field and draws a cell-shaded mesh with contour ridges, an ember-to-teal elevation ramp and a survey reticle following the pointer. Move to read elevation; press and drag to raise terrain; switch dunes, peaks and crater height functions, adjust relief, wind and grid sliders, or freeze the wind. The craft is a real-time height field and survey-style UI. Boundary: generative terrain, not a real DEM or survey.

title.zh: 气候账本：把升温记录做成收据
title.en: Climate Ledger: Warming as a Receipt

notes.zh: 一本深森林黑底的气候账本：墨绿表头、琥珀警告与红色警报，同一套柱状引擎讲排放、升温与海冰三组故事，另有异常穹顶仪表、海洋热含量环图与可再生比例计数器；标签切换数据集，点柱隔离占比，Replay / 1990 重绘或改基线，海洋 / 陆地按钮重塑环图。看点是统一图表引擎与账本式排版。边界：示意性数据叙事，不是官方气候记录；引用前应回查原始数据集。
notes.en: A climate ledger on deep forest black: ink-green headers, amber warnings and red alarms, with one bar engine telling emissions, temperature and sea-ice stories, plus a domed anomaly gauge, an ocean-heat donut and a renewable projection counter. Tabs swap datasets, clicking a bar isolates its share, Replay / 1990 redraw or rebaseline, and ocean/land buttons reshape the donut. The craft is one chart engine and receipt-like layout. Boundary: an illustrative data story, not an official climate record; check the underlying dataset before quoting.

title.zh: 剪纸山谷：四层纸片的视差
title.en: Paper Cutout: A Valley in Four Layers

notes.zh: 一座硬阴影剪纸立体模型：松林山脊、木屋山坡、草地与前景土壤四层 SVG 纸片，太阳上下浮动、云与鸟漂移；指针横向移动会按层深产生视差，黎明 / 正午 / 黄昏标签切换配色与太阳高度，另有视差、微风、太阳滑杆与压平阴影开关。看点是纸片层深与手工感。边界：纸艺插画，不是真实地形图。
notes.en: A hard-shadow paper diorama: four SVG paper layers — pine ridge, cabin hill, meadow and foreground loam — under a bobbing sun, drifting clouds and homing birds. Moving the pointer scrubs parallax by layer depth; dawn, noon and dusk tabs swap palettes and sun height, with parallax, breeze and sun sliders plus a flatten-shadows toggle. The craft is paper layer depth and handmade feel. Boundary: a paper illustration, not a real topographic map.

title.zh: 色彩理论实验室：一台包豪斯配色印刷机
title.en: Color Theory Lab: A Bauhaus Color Press

notes.zh: 一台暖纸上的包豪斯配色工具：Canvas 色相轮、RGB 滑杆、互补 / 类似 / 三角 / 四角调和条、双墨混合槽与实时渐变、WCAG 对比度检查与色库；点色轮取色、固定色片、复制 hex，AA 框会即时翻转前景与背景。看点是可操作的色彩关系与印刷感硬阴影。边界：教学与灵感工具，不是印刷校色或品牌规范。
notes.en: A Bauhaus color press on warm paper: canvas hue wheel, RGB sliders, complement / analogous / triad / tetrad harmony strips, two-ink wells blending into a live gradient, a WCAG contrast checker and a swatch library. Pick hues on the wheel, pin swatches, copy hex, and the AA box flips foreground and background live. The craft is operable colour relationships with print-like hard shadows. Boundary: a teaching and inspiration tool, not print calibration or a brand standard.

title.zh: 黄铜太阳仪：六颗行星的真实相对速度
title.en: Orrery Mechanica: A Brass Solar Machine

notes.zh: 一台 inline SVG 黄铜太阳仪：同心蚀刻轨道、齿轮太阳、六颗珐琅行星按开普勒相对角速度运行，深咖啡木纹底、秒刻环与椭圆投影；右侧博物馆式铭牌列出恒星周期，选中行星会亮起对应轨道、显示规格卡并让黄铜指针滑到轨道距离，拖动可把时间速度从 0 调到 20×。看点是 SVG 机械细节与真实比例速度。边界：装饰性近似模型，不是星历或天文台数据。
notes.en: An inline-SVG brass orrery: concentric engraved orbits, a geared sun and six enamel planets moving at Kepler-proportional angular speeds over espresso wood, with a seconds ring and elliptical projection. A museum plaque lists sidereal periods; selecting a planet brightens its orbit, opens a spec card and eases a brass gauge needle to its distance. Drag to scrub time speed from 0 to 20×. The craft is SVG mechanical detail and true relative speeds. Boundary: a decorative approximation, not an ephemeris or observatory dataset.

title.zh: 孟菲斯玩具箱：三种能玩的玩具
title.en: Memphis Toybox: Three Toys You Can Play

notes.zh: 一张暖奶油底的孟菲斯游乐页：边角散落手绘波浪线、彩纸点、锯齿与基本形，中央旋转标题带黄色错位阴影，下面三张白卡各装一个真玩具——弹簧形状分类器、可拉拽的晃动弹簧、带惯性甩动的旋转器；点背景会爆出六片彩纸屑。看点是 SVG 虚线动画、指针物理与硬阴影。边界：玩具页，物理为近似演示，不是工程仿真。
notes.en: A joyful Memphis playground on warm cream: hand-drawn squiggles, confetti dots, zigzags and primitives scatter the margins, a rotated headline carries yellow offset shadows, and three white cards each hold a real toy — a springy shape sorter, a pullable wobble spring and a flick spinner with momentum. Clicking the background bursts six confetti pieces. The craft is SVG dash animation, pointer physics and hard shadows. Boundary: a toy page; the physics is an approximation, not engineering simulation.

title.zh: 天鹅绒招牌：用灯泡拼出你的字
title.en: Velvet Marquee: Spell It in Light Bulbs

notes.zh: 一座复古剧院门头：酒红天鹅绒幕布、金流苏帷幔、黑漆招牌与一圈追逐暖灯；输入最多 12 个字符，字母会被排成 5×7 灯泡矩阵，CHASE / TWINKLE / SCROLL 三种灯效与速度滑杆实时改变，幕布可拉开露出奶油标题卡，下方四张斜放剧目单。看点是灯泡矩阵字体与剧场材质。边界：虚构剧院与剧目，不连接真实招牌硬件。
notes.en: A vintage theatre marquee: swagged crimson curtains, a gold-fringed valance, a lacquered board and a ring of chasing warm bulbs. Type up to twelve characters and they render as 5×7 bulb matrices; CHASE / TWINKLE / SCROLL and a tempo slider change the animation live, the curtain can part to reveal a cream title card, and four tilted playbills sit below. The craft is bulb-matrix lettering and theatre materiality. Boundary: fictional theatre and bill; it does not control real signage hardware.

title.zh: 金継ぎ：把七片瓷碗拖回原位
title.en: Kintsugi: Seven Shards, Seven Gold Seams

notes.zh: 一场互动金継仪式：青瓷碗碎成七片，散落在深靛麻布上，虚线幽灵轮廓标出每片的位置；把碎片拖近，弹簧吸附归位，一道金缝沿裂口自绘并闪出微光与火花，计数器从 0/7 递增，最后一片归位后浮出俳句与整屏金光，BREAK AGAIN 可重新打碎。旁边有关于 urushi 与侘寂的博物馆式说明。看点是 SVG 扇形几何与描边动画。边界：象征性仪式，不是真实陶瓷修复教程，也不涉及食品接触安全。
notes.en: An interactive kintsugi ritual: a celadon bowl broken into seven shards scattered on dark indigo linen, with dashed ghost outlines marking each home. Drag a shard close and it snaps in with a spring ease; a gold seam draws itself along the crack with shimmer and sparks, the counter ticks from 0/7, and after the last shard a haiku and a full-screen gold bloom appear. BREAK AGAIN scatters it. Museum-style notes mention urushi and wabi-sabi. The craft is SVG wedge geometry and stroke animation. Boundary: a symbolic ritual, not a real ceramic-repair tutorial or food-contact safety guide.

title.zh: 冰川退却：一条 1900→2026 的山谷时间轴

notes.zh: 一条用同一座程序化山谷讲完的冰川退却时间轴：拖动 1900–2026 年份滑杆，冰舌持续变短变薄，冰碛垄从退却末端露出，绿松石色冰前湖扩张，草甸沿谷底上爬；场景内钉着「首次测量照片」「A-4 花杆」等里程碑，数据卡实时显示冰面积 14.2→4.1 km²、退却米数与湖泊公顷，PLAY CENTURY 自动播放 126 年，WINTER 叠加季节雪。看点是关键帧状态表逐帧插值。边界：示意性重建，不是实测冰川记录；数字为情景值。
notes.en: A glacier-retreat timeline told through one procedural valley: drag the 1900–2026 year slider and the ice tongue shortens and thins, moraine ridges emerge behind the terminus, a turquoise proglacial lake swells and meadow creeps up the floor. Milestone flags mark “First survey photo” and “Stake A-4”; a data card tracks ice area from 14.2 to 4.1 km², retreat metres and lake hectares. PLAY CENTURY runs 126 years, WINTER adds seasonal snow. The craft is a keyframe state table interpolated per frame. Boundary: an illustrative reconstruction, not measured glacier data; figures are scenario values.

title.zh: 玫瑰窗：可以转动的手工彩绘玻璃
title.en: Rose Window: A Stained-Glass Rose You Can Spin

notes.zh: 一扇全屏生成式玫瑰窗：一整段手写 SVG 字符串，12 个外层花瓣、两圈各 8 扇尖拱窗与中心同心圆花饰，红宝石、蓝宝石、祖母绿、琥珀与透明玻璃由粗黑窗棂分隔；玻璃后有三层缓慢呼吸的光泄漏渐变，拖动可带弹簧惯性旋转，NOON / DUSK / STORM 三套光照会同时换背景、漏光颜色与 HUD 墨色，LUX ET VERITAS 沿 textPath 环绕。看点是扇形与尖拱路径数学。边界：生成式装饰，不是真实教堂窗户或建筑测绘。
notes.en: A full-viewport generative rose window built from one hand-written SVG string: twelve outer petals, two rings of eight lancets and a layered central rosette, panelled in ruby, sapphire, emerald, amber and clear glass between heavy black mullions. Three slowly breathing light-leak gradients sit behind the glass; drag to spin with spring inertia, and NOON / DUSK / STORM presets swap background, leak colours and HUD ink together. LUX ET VERITAS runs along a textPath. The craft is sector and lancet path mathematics. Boundary: generative decoration, not a real cathedral window or architectural survey.

title.zh: 像素花园：十六乘十的四季花圃
title.en: Pixel Garden: A 16×10 Farm Through Four Seasons

notes.zh: 一座 16×10 的大格像素花圃：季节每 40 秒在春、夏、秋、冬之间平滑过渡，冬季会下雪并在未收获的花上结霜；SEED 播种后经四个生长阶段在 20 秒内开花，WATER 让生长速度翻倍并闪蓝，HARVEST 收花加分，顶部显示季节与零填充分数。看点是逐格 Canvas 绘制与季节调色板插值。边界：小游戏，不是真实种植或园艺建议。
notes.en: A 16×10 big-tile pixel garden: seasons lerp through spring, summer, autumn and winter every forty seconds, with snow and frost on unharvested flowers in winter. SEED plants a sprout that passes four growth stages in twenty seconds; WATER doubles growth with a blue pulse; HARVEST pops the bloom and adds to a zero-padded score, while the header shows the season. The craft is tile-by-tile canvas drawing and seasonal palette interpolation. Boundary: a small game, not real planting or gardening advice.

title.zh: 等距房间：一间能开关灯的小屋
title.en: ISO Room: A Cozy Isometric Interior

notes.zh: 一间用真实等距投影画出的舒适房间：8×8 胡桃木棋盘地板、两面奶油墙、带昼夜天空与会月亮的窗；床、书桌、播放像素小视频的显示器、会摇的盆栽、地毯与暖光台灯都由等距盒子拼成，每件投下柔和椭圆阴影。DAY/NIGHT 切换窗景、灯光与屏幕亮度，悬停家具会抬起 4px 并显示标签，点台灯会闪一下再亮。看点是画家排序与 Canvas 等距数学。边界：室内插画，不是 CAD 或可编辑 3D 场景。
notes.en: A cozy room drawn with true isometric projection: an 8×8 walnut checker floor, two cream walls and a window with a day-night sky and crescent moon. Bed, desk, a monitor playing a tiny scrolling pixel video, a swaying plant, rug and warm lamp are all built from isometric boxes, each with a soft elliptical shadow. DAY/NIGHT swaps the window, lamp glow and screen brightness; hovering lifts furniture 4px with a label, and clicking the lamp flickers then glows. The craft is painter’s-order depth and canvas isometric maths. Boundary: an interior illustration, not CAD or an editable 3D scene.

title.zh: 包豪斯 07 号：六块纯色形状的平衡
title.en: Bauhaus / Form 07: Six Flat Shapes in Balance

notes.zh: 一张 1923 年风格的包豪斯几何海报：12×12 淡网格纸、黑色 keyline，红圆、黑半圆、橙三角、45° 蓝方、金色半环带与细黑线六种纯平形状，从四套不对称平衡版式中取一套，并带种子化的尺寸、旋转与位置变化；悬停任何形状会炸成三片错位切片再弹回，点画面重新构图，底部有 1923 圆印与窄字距说明。看点是零渐变、严格几何与切片 clip-path。边界：对包豪斯风格的同代致敬，不是原作或历史文物。
notes.en: A 1923-style Bauhaus geometric poster: 12×12 grid paper, a black keyline, and six flat forms — red circle, black half-circle, orange triangle, 45° blue square, gold half-ring band and thin black lines — placed from one of four asymmetric-but-balanced layouts with seeded size, rotation and position. Hover any form to explode it into three offset slices and snap back; click to recompose. A 1923 seal and narrow caption sit below. The craft is zero gradients, strict geometry and clip-path slicing. Boundary: a period-style homage, not an original Bauhaus artwork or historical object.

title.zh: 像素农场：十乘六的完整种植循环

notes.zh: 一块 10×6 的低分辨率像素农场：从泥土、犁沟、幼苗、两段生长到发光成熟，成熟后 30 秒不收会枯成杂草；TILL / SEED / WATER / HARVEST 四种工具，浇水 6 秒内增速 1.5×，天气与昼夜会改变生长速度，顶部木框 HUD 显示金币、天数与太阳 / 云 / 月亮。看点是完整状态机与像素化放大。边界：游戏循环，不是真实农业模型。
notes.en: A 10×6 low-resolution pixel farm: dirt, tilled rows, sprout, two growth stages and a glowing ready crop, which withers into weeds after thirty seconds unharvested. TILL / SEED / WATER / HARVEST tools; watering boosts growth 1.5× for six seconds; weather and day-night modify speed; a wooden HUD shows gold, day and sun/cloud/moon. The craft is a complete tile state machine and pixelated upscale. Boundary: a game loop, not a real agriculture model.

notes.zh: 一个虚构大气设计工作室的单页：全屏极光带、星空、实时时钟与经纬度并置，滚动时前后景分层移动；页面里的 “Watch the reel” 是站内演示入口，不是视频文件。边界：品牌、奖项与坐标都是虚构设定，页面不接真实天气或项目数据。
notes.en: A fictional atmospheric-design studio in one page: full-screen aurora ribbons, a star field, a live clock and latitude/longitude sit together; scrolling moves the layers at different depths. “Watch the reel” is an in-page demo cue, not a video file. Boundary: the brand, awards and coordinates are invented; no live weather or project data.

title.zh: Haptic：一块更安静的瓷面控制器
title.en: Haptic: a softer porcelain control surface

notes.zh: 一块瓷面控制器：拖动旋钮在 0–100 间改变强度，四种情绪可切换，指针靠近时出现微光而不是蜂鸣；提示音由 Web Audio 在本地合成。边界：交互、材质与“电容传感”都是前端演示，没有连接真实硬件。
notes.en: A porcelain control surface: drag the dial from 0 to 100, switch among four moods, and a faint glow (not a buzzer) acknowledges the pointer; the cue is synthesised locally with Web Audio. Boundary: the interaction, material and “capacitive sensor” are front-end theatre; nothing is wired to hardware.

notes.zh: 雨夜夜市单页：canvas 画雨丝、霓虹招牌与三个摊位，点击场景触发闪电，向下滚动进入市场；降雨量、营业时间与“传输 04”都是页面里的气氛数据。边界：没有真实交易、定位或商户信息。
notes.en: A rainy night market in one page: canvas rain, neon signs and three stalls; clicking the scene triggers lightning and scrolling enters the market. Rainfall, opening hours and “Transmission 04” are atmospheric data inside the page. Boundary: no real transactions, location or vendor data.

title.en: Borealis: a glass sanctuary above the fjord

notes.zh: 一座虚构的极光玻璃展亭：canvas 极光、玻璃折射层与音景叠在一起，指针移动改变“太阳风”强度，四种玻璃材质可切换；页面把建筑、光与声音当成同一套材料来演示。边界：场地、建筑与声景均为虚构，未接实时地磁数据。
notes.en: A fictional aurora-glass pavilion: canvas aurora, refractive glass layers and a soundscape overlap; moving the pointer changes “solar wind” strength and four glass materials can be switched. Architecture, light and sound are treated as one material system. Boundary: site, building and soundscape are invented; no live geomagnetic feed.

notes.zh: 一台口袋合成器：四组控件分别调 tempo、cutoff、decay 与 transpose，canvas 画出波形，Web Audio 实时发声；Run / Loop 切换运行方式。边界：声音在浏览器本地合成，没有采样库，也没有 MIDI 或硬件输入。
notes.en: A pocket synthesiser: four controls set tempo, cutoff, decay and transpose; canvas draws the waveform and Web Audio makes sound live, with Run / Loop switching the transport. Boundary: audio is synthesised in the browser, with no sample library, MIDI or hardware input.

notes.zh: 1975 年阿波罗-联盟对接控制台：琥珀色 CRT、RCS 推进器键盘控制、交会距离与 X/Y 轴误差实时更新，目标是把目标框对进瞄准标线。边界：轨道与推进剂数据是前端模拟，不对应真实任务遥测。
notes.en: A 1975 Apollo-Soyuz docking console: amber CRT, RCS thruster control from the keyboard, live range and X/Y axis error; the task is to put the target inside the reticle. Boundary: orbital and propellant data are simulated in the front end, not real mission telemetry.

notes.zh: 暗色登录页：输入邮箱与口令时，极光与星场随光标移动，提交后出现 “Neural handshake complete” 状态；口令可见性与“恢复”入口都在页内。边界：表单不发送数据，状态文案是演示，没有真实账户后端。
notes.en: An after-dark sign-in: as you type an email and passphrase the aurora and star field follow the cursor; submitting shows “Neural handshake complete”. Passphrase visibility and recovery live inside the page. Boundary: the form sends nothing; the status copy is a demo and there is no account backend.

notes.zh: 拟态音乐播放器：唱片旋转、进度与音量控件、随机播放与 “side a” 曲目切换；封面、曲名与时长都是虚构素材。边界：播放状态由前端模拟，不加载真实音频文件，“33⅓ rpm” 只是视觉设定。
notes.en: A neumorphic music player: a spinning record, progress and volume controls, shuffle and “side a” track switching. Covers, titles and durations are invented. Boundary: playback is simulated in the front end with no real audio file; “33⅓ rpm” is a visual conceit.

notes.zh: 流场图集：value-noise 驱动的粒子被指针搅动，按 R 生成新图版，四套配色可换；页面显示粒子数、fps 与 seed，像一本可操作的地图册。边界：fps 是页面自报，没有导出矢量或科研数据。
notes.en: A flow-field atlas: value-noise particles are stirred by the pointer, R makes a new plate and four palettes can be switched. Particle count, fps and seed are shown like an interactive atlas. Boundary: fps is self-reported; there is no vector export or research data.

notes.zh: 四章滚动叙事：随着滚动，canvas 海面与文字章节切换，文字描述“八秒周期的涌浪”与岸边的嘶声；页面没有音频文件，声音只存在于文字与画面。边界：这是叙事演示，不是海洋观测或声音可视化工具。
notes.en: A four-chapter scroll story: scrolling switches the canvas sea and text chapters; the copy describes an eight-second swell and the hiss at the sand bar. There is no audio file — sound exists only in words and image. Boundary: a narrative demo, not ocean observation or a sound-visualisation tool.

notes.zh: 重力沙盒：拖动中心质量，粒子群在约两秒内重新组织，能量与轨迹实时显示；可暂停、重置与切换“Core / Trace”。边界：牛顿式近似模拟，不是物理引擎基准，也没有导出轨迹。
notes.en: A gravity sandbox: drag the central mass and the particles reorganise in about two seconds, with live energy and trails; pause, reset and switch “Core / Trace”. Boundary: a Newtonian approximation, not a physics-engine benchmark, and trails cannot be exported.

notes.zh: 七层纸雕世界：拖动画面把图层拉开，每一座山都是撕纸边；Evening 与 Reset 切换光线和层距。边界：图层是 CSS/SVG 平面叠放，不是真 3D 模型，也没有可下载的剪纸文件。
notes.en: A seven-layer papercut world: drag the picture to pull the layers apart; every hill is a torn edge. Evening and Reset change the light and layer spacing. Boundary: layers are stacked CSS/SVG planes, not a true 3D model, and there is no downloadable cut file.

title.en: Aurora Ops: a glass data dashboard

notes.zh: 玻璃态数据看板：KPI 数字滚动、极光背景、连接钱包与“2 分钟导览”入口；SLA、事件量、P95 延迟都是演示指标。边界：没有后端、没有真实钱包连接，指标数字由前端生成。
notes.en: A glass data dashboard: KPI numbers roll, an aurora sits behind the glass, with connect-wallet and a two-minute tour. SLA, event volume and P95 latency are demo metrics. Boundary: no backend, no real wallet connection; the numbers are generated in the front end.

notes.zh: 奶油底上的墨流：Perlin 噪声驱动数千粒子，指针可把墨迹分开，点击播下新种子；Seed、粒子数与暂停状态都在页面上。边界：生成结果不保存，刷新即失去当前画面。
notes.en: Ink on cream: Perlin noise drives thousands of particles; the pointer parts the ink and a click seeds a new field. Seed, particle count and pause state are shown. Boundary: nothing is saved; refreshing loses the current drawing.

notes.zh: 等距小城从 06:00 开始走完一天：窗口灯光、车流与天空颜色随时间变化，建筑保持同一套等距网格。边界：城市、车流与时间轴都是虚构，页面不读取本地时间。
notes.en: An isometric little city runs from 06:00 through a full day: window lights, traffic and sky colour change with time while the buildings stay on one isometric grid. Boundary: city, traffic and timeline are invented; the page does not read local time.

notes.zh: 深空三星体：环状巨行星、凌日的冰矮星与边缘余烬同框，指针移动产生视差，赤经赤纬与漂移值实时更新。边界：天体与轨道为虚构，坐标只是页面参数。
notes.en: Three bodies in one deep field: a ringed giant, an ice dwarf in transit and an ember at the edge; pointer movement creates parallax while RA/DEC and drift update. Boundary: bodies and orbits are invented; coordinates are page parameters.

title.en: Liquid Bloom: six bodies of light

notes.zh: 六团有机光体在暗场里呼吸：指针靠近时整体向光标倾斜，点击送出一圈涟漪；形状由分层噪声缓慢变形。边界：没有物理模拟或导出，刷新后形态重新生成。
notes.en: Six organic bodies of light breathe in the dark: the bloom leans toward the pointer and a click sends a ripple; layered noise slowly warps the outlines. Boundary: no physics or export; shapes regenerate on refresh.

notes.zh: 百点星图：指针吸引粒子，按住 Shift 改为排斥，点击播出一场星爆；编号“011/100”提示它是整组实验中的一件。边界：节点之间没有真实关系，连线只是距离阈值。
notes.en: A hundred-node star map: the pointer attracts particles, Shift repels, and a click seeds a burst; “011/100” marks it as one study in a set. Boundary: nodes have no real relationships; links are only a distance threshold.

notes.zh: 北极光观测站：KP 指数、Alta 地点与 canvas 天空并置，“Wake the aurora” 把极光从平静推到增强，Calm / Storm 等状态可切换。边界：KP 与天气为演示数据，未接任何空间天气 API。
notes.en: A northern-lights observatory: KP index, the Alta location and a canvas sky sit together; “Wake the aurora” pushes the display from calm to storm, with states that can be switched. Boundary: KP and weather are demo data; no space-weather API is connected.

title.en: INKBLOOM: a studio for wet ink

notes.zh: 湿墨工作室：在纸上点击或拖动，闭合曲线被多层噪声扭曲成墨晕；Pigment、Flow、Bleed 三个滑块控制浓淡、流向与扩散，Auto 生成新纸。边界：墨迹是程序生成，不是扫描素材，也不能导出印刷文件。
notes.en: A wet-ink studio: click or drag on the paper and a closed curve is warped by layered noise into a bloom; Pigment, Flow and Bleed control density, direction and spread, while Auto makes a new sheet. Boundary: the ink is generated, not scanned, and cannot be exported for print.

title.en: ORRERY: a working model of the inner sky

notes.zh: 内太阳系仪：模拟速度、轨道尺度与标签开关，拖拽平移、滚轮缩放、点击天体查看半径/公转周期；日期与角度随模拟推进。边界：轨道是简化圆/椭圆模型，不用于天文计算。
notes.en: A working model of the inner solar system: simulation speed, orbit scale and labels can be toggled; drag to pan, wheel to zoom, click a body for radius and period, while date and angle advance. Boundary: simplified circular/elliptical orbits, not for astronomical calculation.

title.en: Night Garden: a botanical study after dark

notes.zh: 月下花园：一株月花草随 “CLOSE THE BLOOM” 展开或合拢，滚动推进夜色与短句；整页不依赖外部图片，花与光都由 CSS/SVG 画出。边界：植物形态是风格化插画，不是植物学标本。
notes.en: A night garden: a moonflower opens and closes with “CLOSE THE BLOOM”, while scrolling advances the dusk and short lines. The page needs no external images; flower and light are drawn in CSS/SVG. Boundary: the plant is a stylised illustration, not a botanical specimen.

notes.zh: 轨道时钟：三条天体轨迹分别走秒、分、时，页面读取本地时间并持续旋转；没有数字表盘，读时靠轨道位置。边界：这是视觉时钟，不保证与系统时间逐帧同步。
notes.en: An orbit clock: three celestial paths carry seconds, minutes and hours; the page reads local time and keeps moving. There is no digital face — you read time from orbital position. Boundary: a visual clock, not guaranteed frame-accurate to system time.

notes.zh: 虚构地点天气报告：Sunny Island 等卡片切换，暖色渐变、体感与一句“非常适宜什么都不做”的预报并置；每张卡都是一套独立气氛。边界：没有真实气象数据，地点也不存在。
notes.en: A weather report for invented places: cards such as Sunny Island switch, pairing warm gradients and a “very good chance of doing absolutely nothing” forecast; each card is its own atmosphere. Boundary: no real weather data and the places do not exist.

title.zh: GPT-6 Astra：从零完成“找儿科医生”
title.en: GPT-6 Astra: finding a pediatrician, end to end

notes.zh: 演示什么：官方页面嵌入 2 分 54 秒的压缩录屏，模型从零开始完成“找儿科医生”任务——搜索、比较、打开页面、整理信息，并在报告里留下可核对的步骤。官方怎么说：OpenAI 把这段录屏当作 Astra 电脑使用、写作与代码库理解能力的示例，并注明“压缩”。边界：官方挑选的成功案例，没有失败率、任务次数或人工介入记录；录屏经过剪辑，不能当作成功率基准。
notes.en: What it shows: the official page embeds a 2 min 54 sec condensed screen recording of GPT-6 Astra completing a “find a pediatrician” task from scratch — searching, comparing, opening pages, organising information and leaving checkable steps in a report. What the page says: OpenAI presents it as an example of Astra’s computer use, writing and codebase understanding, and labels it “condensed”. Boundary: a selected success case; no failure rate, task count or human interventions. The recording is edited and is not a success-rate benchmark.

notes.en: What it shows: OpenAI uses TIDAL as Astra’s game-generation example — vivid graphics, engaging gameplay and accurate motion, letting non-technical people create and play custom games in minutes. What the page says: OpenAI stresses “beyond rudimentary elements”, but gives no prompt, iteration count or runnable file. Boundary: an official showcase that cannot be independently re-run; visuals and gameplay are curated.

title.en: Images 2.6: turning stills into looping GIFs

notes.zh: 演示什么：官方用一段“动画场景集锦”展示 Images 2.6 的 GIF 能力——品牌吉祥物、角色或产品图可以变成循环动画。官方怎么说：页面同时给出生成速度（比上一代快 50%）与 API 两档模型 Flare / Sunburst，但集锦本身没有逐条提示词。边界：官方 montage 是挑选后的结果，不代表所有静图都能稳定循环；GIF 的色彩、时长与文件大小限制未在页内展开。
notes.en: What it shows: OpenAI uses a montage of animated scenes to demonstrate Images 2.6’s GIF capability — brand mascots, characters or product shots can become loops. notes.en:
What it shows: A cooperative space-mission planning game: plan a trajectory, buy equipment, develop and test hardware and manage partners while sharing one budget and launch schedule; a 2026 NASA Space Apps team project.
How to play: Create or join a game from the title screen; four stations cover planning, procurement, science and communications, and fewer players can take over empty stations.
Boundary: A team project; model use follows the public README, and this is not a controlled evaluation or a complete single-player game; this site only checked that the author page opens and captured a first-frame thumbnail, not a full play-through, and does not treat HTTP 200 as a quality verdict.
